interpretation.text:
Word separation follows general transliteration principles in roman script, thus words are separated whenever possible such as "tac ca", "ity eva".
                    Members of a compound are separated by periods.
                    External sandhi is decomposed with -.
                    The text is based upon Shastri's edition (K). Variants in Medhātithi's commentary (M) are given at the end of each verse. The verse numbers correspond to K. Differing verse numbers in M are given in square brackets. Some verses which are found only in K or M, in these cases a note has been added.

children.text: antaraprabhavānāṃ ca dharmān no vaktum arhasi || 2 ||
tvam eko hy asya sarvasya vidhānasya svayambhuvaḥ |
sa taiḥ pṛṣṭas tathā samyag amita.ojā mahātmabhiḥ |
tataḥ svayambhūr bhagavān avyakto vyañjayann idam |
so 'bhidhyāya śarīrāt svāt sisṛkṣur vividhāḥ prajāḥ |
apa eva sasarja-ādau tāsu vīryam avāsṛjat || 8 ||
āpo narā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ |
tā yad asyāyanaṃ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 10 ||
yat tat kāraṇam avyaktaṃ nityaṃ sad.asad.ātmakaṃ |
tad.visṛṣṭaḥ sa puruṣo loke brahmā-iti kīrtyate || 11 ||
tasminn aṇḍe sa bhagavān uṣitvā parivatsaram |
svayam evātmano dhyānāt tad aṇḍam akarod dvidhā || 12 ||
tābhyāṃ sa śakalābhyāṃ ca divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca nirmame |
madhye vyoma diśaś ca-aṣṭāv apāṃ sthānaṃ ca śāśvataṃ || 13 ||
mahāntam eva ca-ātmānaṃ sarvāṇi tri.guṇāni ca |
teṣāṃ tv avayavān sūkṣmān ṣaṇṇām apy amita.ojasām |
yan mūrti.avayavāḥ sūkṣmās tāni-imāny āśrayanti ṣaṭ |
tasmāt-śarīram ity āhus tasya mūrtiṃ manīṣiṇaḥ || 17 ||
tad āviśanti bhūtāni mahānti saha karmabhiḥ |
teṣām idaṃ tu saptānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ mahā.ojasām |
ādyādyasya guṇaṃ tv eṣām avāpnoti paraḥ paraḥ |
yo yo yāvatithaś ca-eṣāṃ sa sa tāvad guṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 20 ||
sarveṣāṃ tu sa nāmāni karmāṇi ca pṛthak pṛthak |
vedaśabdebhya eva-ādau pṛthak saṃsthāś ca nirmame || 21 ||
karmātmanāṃ ca devānāṃ so 'sṛjat prāṇināṃ prabhuḥ |
sādhyānāṃ ca gaṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ yajñaṃ ca-eva sanātanam || 22 ||
kālaṃ kālavibhaktīś ca nakṣatrāṇi grahāṃs tathā |
tapo vācaṃ ratiṃ ca-eva kāmaṃ ca krodham eva ca |

sṛṣṭiṃ sasarja ca-eva-imāṃ sraṣṭum icchann imāḥ prajāḥ || 25
                            ||
aṇvyo mātrā vināśinyo daśārdhānāṃ tu yāḥ smṛtāḥ |
tābhiḥ sārdham idaṃ sarvaṃ sambhavaty anupūrvaśaḥ || 27 ||
yaṃ tu karmaṇi yasmin sa nyayuṅkta prathamaṃ prabhuḥ |
sa tad eva svayaṃ bheje sṛjyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 28 ||
yad yasya so 'dadhāt sarge tat tasya svayam āviśat || 29 ||
svāni svāny abhipadyante tathā karmāṇi dehinaḥ || 30 ||
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ ca niravartayat || 31 ||
ardhena nārī tasyāṃ sa virājam asṛjat prabhuḥ || 32 ||
tapas taptvā-asṛjad yaṃ tu sa svayaṃ puruṣo virāṭ |
taṃ māṃ vitta-asya sarvasya sraṣṭāraṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 33 ||
ahaṃ prajāḥ sisṛkṣus tu tapas taptvā su.duścaram |
patīn prajānām asṛjaṃ maharṣīn ādito daśa || 34 ||
pracetasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca bhṛguṃ nāradam eva ca || 35 ||
ete manūṃs tu saptān yān asṛjan bhūritejasaḥ |
nāgān sarpān suparṇāṃś ca pitṝṇāṃś ca pṛthaggaṇam || 37 ||
kinnarān vānarān matsyān vividhāṃś ca vihaṅgamān |
paśūn mṛgān manuṣyāṃś ca vyālāṃś ca-ubhayatodataḥ || 39 ||
sarvaṃ ca daṃśa.maśakaṃ sthāvaraṃ ca pṛthagvidham || 40 ||
evam etair idaṃ sarvaṃ mad.niyogān mahātmabhiḥ |
1.4. Excursus: Classification of Fauna and Flora
yeṣāṃ tu yādṛṣaṃ karma bhūtānām iha kīrtitam |
tat tathā vo 'bhidhāsyāmi kramayogaṃ ca janmani || 42 ||
paśavaś ca mṛgāś ca-eva vyālāś ca-ubhayatodataḥ |
rakṣāṃsi ca piśācāś ca manuṣyāś ca jarāyujāḥ || 43 ||
aṇḍājāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarpā nakrā matsyāś ca kacchapāḥ |
ūṣmaṇaś ca-upajāyante yac ca-anyat kiṃ cid īdṛṣam || 45 ||
apuṣpāḥ phalavanto ye te vanaspatayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
puṣpiṇaḥ phalinaś ca-eva vṛkṣās tu-ubhayataḥ smṛtāḥ || 47 ||
bīja.kāṇḍaruhāṇy eva pratānā vallya eva ca || 48 ||
evaṃ sarvaṃ sa sṛṣṭvā-idaṃ māṃ ca-acintya.parākramaḥ |
ātmany antardadhe bhūyaḥ kālaṃ kālena pīḍayan || 51 ||
yadā sa devo jāgarti tad evaṃ ceṣṭate jagat |
yadā svapiti śānta.ātmā tadā sarvaṃ nimīlati || 52 ||
tasmin svapiti tu svasthe karma.ātmānaḥ śarīriṇaḥ |
svakarmabhyo nivartante manaś ca glānim ṛcchati || 53 ||
yugapat tu pralīyante yadā tasmin mahātmani |
tamo 'yaṃ tu samāśritya ciraṃ tiṣṭhati sa.indriyaḥ |
na ca svaṃ kurute karma tadā-utkrāmati mūrtitaḥ || 55 ||
yadā-aṇumātriko bhūtvā bījaṃ sthāsnu cariṣṇu ca |
evaṃ sa jāgrat.svapnābhyām idaṃ sarvaṃ cara.acaram |
idaṃ śāstraṃ tu kṛtvā-asau mām eva svayam āditaḥ |
vidhivad grāhayām āsa marīci.ādīṃs tv ahaṃ munīn || 58 ||
etad vo 'yaṃ bhṛguḥ śāstraṃ śrāvayiṣyaty aśesataḥ |
etadd hi matto 'dhijage sarvam eṣo 'khilaṃ muniḥ || 59 ||
tatas tathā sa tena-ukto maharṣi.manunā bhṛguḥ |
tān abravīd ṛṣīn sarvān prītātmā śrūyatām iti || 60 ||
sṛṣṭavantaḥ prajāḥ svāḥ svā mahātmāno mahā.ojasaḥ || 61 ||
svārociṣaś ca-uttamaś ca tāmaso raivatas tathā |
cākṣuṣaś ca mahātejā vivasvat.suta eva ca || 62 ||
sve sve 'ntare sarvam idam utpādya-āpuś cara.acaram || 63 ||
nimeṣā daśa ca-aṣṭau ca kāṣṭhā triṃśat tu tāḥ kalā |
triṃśat kalā muhūrtaḥ syād ahorātraṃ tu tāvataḥ || 64 ||
rātriḥ svapnāya bhūtānāṃ ceṣṭāyai karmaṇām ahaḥ || 65 ||
pitrye rātri.ahanī māsaḥ pravibhāgas tu pakṣayoḥ |
karma.ceṣṭāsv ahaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śuklaḥ svapnāya śarvarī || 66 ||
daive rātri.ahanī varṣaṃ pravibhāgas tayoḥ punaḥ |
brāhmasya tu kṣapāhasya yat pramāṇaṃ samāsataḥ |
ekaikaśo yugānāṃ tu kramaśas tan nibodhata || 68 ||
catvāry āhuḥ sahasrāṇi varsāṇāṃ tat kṛtaṃ yugam |
tasya tāvat-śatī sandhyā sandhyāṃśaś ca tathāvidhaḥ || 69 ||
yad etat parisaṅkhyātam ādāv eva caturyugam |
brāhmam ekam ahar jñeyaṃ tāvatīṃ rātrim eva ca || 72 ||
tad vai yugasahasrāntaṃ brāhmaṃ puṇyam ahar viduḥ |
rātriṃ ca tāvatīm eva te 'horātravido janāḥ || 73 ||
ākāśaṃ jāyate tasmāt tasya śabdaṃ guṇaṃ viduḥ || 75 ||
balavāñ jāyate vāyuḥ sa vai sparśa.guṇo mataḥ || 76 ||
jyotir utpadyate bhāsvat tad rūpa.guṇam ucyate || 77 ||
jyotiṣaś ca vikurvāṇād āpo rasa.guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ |
adbhyo gandha.guṇā bhūmir ity eṣā sṛṣṭir āditaḥ || 78 ||
yad prāg dvādaśasāhasram uditaṃ daivikaṃ yugam |
manvantarāṇy asaṅkhyāni sargaḥ saṃhāra eva ca |
krīḍann iva-etat kurute parameṣṭhī punaḥ punaḥ || 80 ||
catuṣpāt sakalo dharmaḥ satyaṃ ca-eva kṛte yuge |
na-adharmeṇa-āgamaḥ kaś cin manuṣyān prati vartate || 81 ||
itareṣv āgamād dharmaḥ pādaśas tv avaropitaḥ |
kṛte tretādiṣu hy eṣāṃ āyur hrasati pādaśaḥ || 83 ||
veda.uktam āyur martyānām āśiṣaś ca-eva karmaṇām |
phalanty anuyugaṃ loke prabhāvaś ca śarīriṇām || 84 ||
tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānam ucyate |
dvāpare yajñam evāhur dānam ekaṃ kalau yuge || 86 ||
sarvasya-asya tu sargasya gupti.arthaṃ sa mahā.dyutiḥ |
prajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dānam ijyā.adhyayanam eva ca |
paśūnāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dānam ijyā.adhyayanam eva ca |
vaṇikpathaṃ kusīdaṃ ca vaiśyasya kṛṣim eva ca || 90 ||
ekam eva tu śūdrasya prabhuḥ karma samādiśat |
tasmān medhyatamaṃ tv asya mukham uktaṃ svayambhuvā || 92 ||
taṃ hi svayambhūḥ svād āsyāt tapas taptvā-ādito 'sṛjat |
kavyāni ca-eva pitaraḥ kiṃ bhūtam adhikaṃ tataḥ || 95 ||
buddhimatsu narāḥ śreṣṭhā nareṣu brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 96 ||
utpattir eva viprasya mūrtir dharmasya śāśvatī |
sa hi dharmārtham utpanno brahmabhūyāya kalpate || 98 ||
sarvaṃ svaṃ brāhmaṇasya-idaṃ yat kiṃ cit-jagatīgataṃ |
svam eva brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte svaṃ vaste svaṃ dadāti ca |
svāyambhuvo manur dhīmān idaṃ śāstram akalpayat || 102 ||

śiśyebhyaś ca pravaktavyaṃ samyaṅ na-anyena kena cit || 103
                            ||
punāti paṅktiṃ vaṃśyāṃś ca sapta.sapta para.avarān |
pṛthivīm api ca-eva-imāṃ kṛtsnām eko 'pi so 'rhati || 105 ||
idaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyam idaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ param || 106 ||
caturṇām api varṇānām ācāraś ca-eva śāśvataḥ || 107 ||
ācāraḥ paramo dharmaḥ śruti.uktaḥ smārta eva ca |
tasmād asmin sadā yukto nityaṃ syād ātmavān dvijaḥ || 108 ||
ācārād vicyuto vipro na vedaphalam aśnute |
evam ācārato dṛṣṭvā dharmasya munayo gatiṃ |
sarvasya tapaso mūlam ācāraṃ jagṛhuḥ param || 110 ||
jagataś ca samutpattiṃ saṃskāravidhim eva ca |
vratacaryā.upacāraṃ ca snānasya ca paraṃ vidhim || 111 ||
vṛttīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca-eva snātakasya vratāni ca |

bhakṣya.abhakṣyaṃ ca śaucaṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ śuddhim eva ca || 113
                            ||
strīdharma.yogaṃ tāpasyaṃ mokṣaṃ sannyāsam eva ca |
rājñaś ca dharmam akhilaṃ kāryāṇāṃ ca vinirṇayam || 114 ||
vibhāgadharmaṃ dyūtaṃ ca kaṇṭakānāṃ ca śodhanam || 115 ||
yathā-idam uktavān-śāstraṃ purā pṛṣṭo manur mayā |
kāmātmatā na praśastā na ca-eva-iha-asty akāmatā |
kāmyo hi vedādhigamaḥ karmayogaś ca vaidikaḥ || 2 ||
vratāni yamadharmāś ca sarve saṅkalpajāḥ smṛtāḥ || 3 ||
a.kāmasya kriyā kā cid dṛśyate na-iha karhi cit |

yad yadd hi kurute kiṃ cit tat tat kāmasya ceṣṭitam || 4
                                ||
yathā saṅkalpitāṃś ca-iha sarvān kāmān samaśnute || 5 ||
ācāraś ca-eva sādhūnām ātmanas tuṣṭir eva ca || 6 ||
yaḥ kaś cit kasya cid dharmo manunā parikīrtitaḥ |
sa sarvo 'bhihito vede sarvajñānamayo hi saḥ || 7 ||
iha kīrtim avāpnoti pretya ca-anuttamaṃ sukham || 9 ||
śrutis tu vedo vijñeyo dharmaśāstraṃ tu vai smṛtiḥ |

te sarvārtheṣv a.mīmāṃsye tābhyāṃ dharmo hi nirbabhau || 10
                                ||
vedaḥ smṛtiḥ sadācāraḥ svasya ca priyam ātmanaḥ |

etac caturvidhaṃ prāhuḥ sākṣād dharmasya lakṣaṇam || 12
                                ||
śrutidvaidhaṃ tu yatra syāt tatra dharmāv ubhau smṛtau |
ubhāv api hi tau dharmau samyag uktau manīṣibhiḥ || 14 ||
sarvathā vartate yajña iti-iyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ || 15 ||

tasya śāstre 'dhikāro 'smiñ jñeyo na-anyasya kasya cit || 16
                                ||
kurukṣetraṃ ca matsyāś ca pañcālāḥ śūrasenakāḥ |

svaṃ svaṃ caritraṃ śikṣeran pṛthivyāṃ sarvamānavāḥ || 20
                                ||
himavad.vindhyayor madhyaṃ yat prāg vinaśanād api |
pratyag eva prayāgāc ca madhyadeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 21 ||
ā samudrāt tu vai pūrvād ā samudrāc ca paścimāt |
tayor eva-antaraṃ giryor āryāvartaṃ vidur budhāḥ || 22 ||
kṛṣṇasāras tu carati mṛgo yatra svabhāvataḥ |
sa jñeyo yajñiyo deśo mlecchadeśas tv ataḥ paraḥ || 23 ||
śūdras tu yasmin kasmin vā nivased vṛttikarśitaḥ || 24 ||
eṣā dharmasya vo yoniḥ samāsena prakīrtitā |
kāryaḥ śarīrasaṃskāraḥ pāvanaḥ pretya ca-iha ca || 26 ||

mahāyajñaiś ca yajñaiś ca brāhmī-iyaṃ kriyate tanuḥ || 28
                                ||
nāmadheyaṃ daśamyāṃ tu dvādaśyāṃ vā-asya kārayet |
puṇye tithau muhūrte vā nakṣatre vā guṇānvite || 30 ||
caturthe māsi kartavyaṃ śiśor niṣkramaṇaṃ gṛhāt |

ṣaṣṭhe 'nnaprāśanaṃ māsi yad vā-iṣṭaṃ maṅgalaṃ kule || 34
                                ||

garbhād ekādaśe rājño garbhāt tu dvādaśe viśaḥ || 36
                                    ||

ā dvāviṃśāt kṣatrabandhor ā caturviṃśater viśaḥ || 38
                                    ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ trayo 'py ete yathākālam a.saṃskṛtāḥ |
na-etair a.pūtair vidhivad āpady api hi karhi cit |

brāhmān yaunāṃś ca sambandhān na-ācared brāhmaṇaḥ saha ||
                                    40 ||
mauñjī trivṛt samā ślakṣṇā kāryā viprasya mekhalā |

kṣatriyasya tu maurvī jyā vaiśyasya śaṇatāntavī || 42
                                    ||

trivṛtā granthinā-ekena tribhiḥ pañcabhir eva vā || 43
                                    ||
lalāṭasammito rājñaḥ syāt tu nāsāntiko viśaḥ || 46 ||
ṛjavas te tu sarve syur a.vraṇāḥ saumya.darśanāḥ |

bhavan.madhyaṃ tu rājanyo vaiśyas tu bhavad.uttaram || 49
                                    ||
mātaraṃ vā svasāraṃ vā mātur vā bhaginīṃ nijām |

bhikṣeta bhikṣām prathamaṃ yā ca-enaṃ na-avamānayet || 50
                                    ||
samāhṛtya tu tad bhaikṣaṃ yāvadannam a.māyayā |

śriyaṃ pratyaṅ.mukho bhuṅkte ṛtaṃ bhuṅkte hy udaṅ.mukhaḥ
                                    || 52 ||
upaspṛśya dvijo nityam annam adyāt samāhitaḥ |

bhuktvā ca-upaspṛśet samyag adbhiḥ khāni ca saṃspṛśet ||
                                    53 ||
pūjayed aśanaṃ nityam adyāc ca-etad a.kutsayan |

dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyet prasīdec ca pratinandec ca sarvaśaḥ || 54
                                    ||
pūjitaṃ hy aśanaṃ nityaṃ balam ūrjaṃ ca yacchati |

a.pūjitaṃ tu tad bhuktam ubhayaṃ nāśayed idam || 55
                                    ||

na-ucchiṣṭaṃ kasya cid dadyān na-adyād etat tathā-antarā
                                    |

na ca-eva-atyaśanaṃ kuryān na ca-ucchiṣṭaḥ kva cid vrajet
                                    || 56 ||

kāya.traidaśikābhyāṃ vā na pitryeṇa kadā cana || 58
                                    ||

kāyam aṅgulimūle 'gre devaṃ pitryaṃ tayor adhaḥ || 59
                                    ||
trir ācāmed apaḥ pūrvaṃ dviḥ pramṛjyāt tato mukham |

khāni ca-eva spṛśed adbhir ātmānaṃ śira eva ca || 60
                                    ||
hṛdgābhiḥ pūyate vipraḥ kaṇṭhagābhis tu bhūmipaḥ |

vaiśyo 'dbhiḥ prāśitābhis tu śūdraḥ spṛṣṭābhir antataḥ ||
                                    62 ||
a.mantrikā tu kāryā-iyaṃ strīṇām āvṛd aśeṣataḥ |
vaivāhiko vidhiḥ strīṇāṃ saṃskāro vaidikaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ācāram agnikāryaṃ ca sandhyā.upāsanam eva ca || 69 ||
brahmārambhe 'vasāne ca pādau grāhyau guroḥ sadā |

saṃhatya hastāv adhyeyaṃ sa hi brahmāñjaliḥ smṛtaḥ || 71
                                ||
savyena savyaḥ spraṣṭavyo dakṣiṇena ca dakṣiṇaḥ || 72 ||
adhīṣva bho iti brūyād virāmo 'stv iti ca-āramet || 73 ||
brahmanaḥ praṇavaṃ kuryād ādāv ante ca sarvadā |
sravaty an.oṅkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ parastāc ca viśīryati || 74 ||
prāṇāyāmais tribhiḥ pūtas tata oṃ.kāram arhati || 75 ||
a.kāraṃ ca-apy u.kāraṃ ca ma.kāraṃ ca prajāpatiḥ |

vedatrayāt-niraduhad bhūr bhuvaḥ svar iti-iti ca || 76
                                    ||
tribhya eva tu vedebhyaḥ pādaṃ pādam adūduhat |

tad ity ṛco 'syāḥ sāvitryāḥ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ || 77
                                    ||
etad akṣaram etāṃ ca japan vyāhṛti.pūrvikām |
sahasrakṛtvas tv abhyasya bahir etat trikaṃ dvijaḥ |
etayā-ṛcā visaṃyuktaḥ kāle ca kriyayā svayā |

tri.padā ca-eva sāvitrī vijñeyaṃ brahmaṇo mukham || 81
                                    ||

yo 'dhīte 'hany ahany etāṃ trīṇi varṣāṇy a.tandritaḥ
                                    |

sa brahma param abhyeti vāyubhūtaḥ kha.mūrtimān || 82
                                    ||
ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma prāṇāyāmaḥ paraṃ tapaḥ |

sāvitryās tu paraṃ na-asti maunāt satyaṃ viśiṣyate || 83
                                    ||
akṣaraṃ duṣkaraṃ jñeyaṃ brahma ca-eva prajāpatiḥ || 84 ||

sarve te japayajñasya kalāṃ na-arhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 86
                                    ||
japyena-eva tu saṃsidhyed brāhmaṇo na-atra saṃśayaḥ |

kuryād anyan na vā kuryān maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate || 87
                                    ||
saṃyame yatnam ātiṣṭhed vidvān yantā-iva vājinām || 88 ||
śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā ca-eva pañcamī |

pāyu.upasthaṃ hasta.pādaṃ vāk ca-eva daśamī smṛtā || 90
                                ||
yasmin jite jitāv etau bhavataḥ pañcakau gaṇau || 92 ||
sanniyamya tu tāny eva tataḥ siddhiṃ nigacchati || 93 ||
na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānām upabhogena śāmyati |

yaś ca-etān prāpnuyāt sarvān yaś ca-etān kevalāṃs tyajet
                                |
vedās tyāgaś ca yajñāś ca niyamāś ca tapāṃsi ca |

na vipraduṣṭa.bhāvasya siddhiṃ gacchati karhi cit || 97
                                ||
śrutvā spṛṣṭvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca bhuktvā ghrātvā ca yo naraḥ |
na hṛṣyati glāyati vā sa vijñeyo jita.indriyaḥ || 98 ||
indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ yady ekaṃ kṣarati-indriyam |
tena-asya kṣarati prajñā dṛteḥ pādād iva-udakam || 99 ||
vaśe kṛtvā-indriyagrāmaṃ saṃyamya ca manas tathā |

sarvān saṃsādhayed arthān a.kṣiṇvan yogatas tanum || 100
                                ||
pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ japāṃs tiṣṭhet sāvitrīm ā.arkadarśanāt |
pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃs tiṣṭhan naiśam eno vyapohati |
paścimām tu samāsīno malaṃ hanti divākṛtam || 102 ||
na tiṣṭhati tu yaḥ pūrvāṃ na-upāste yaś ca paścimām |
apāṃ samīpe niyato naityakaṃ vidhim āsthitaḥ |
naityake na-asty anadhyāyo brahmasattraṃ hi tat smṛtam |
yaḥ svādhyāyam adhīte 'bdaṃ vidhinā niyataḥ śuciḥ |

tasya nityaṃ kṣaraty eṣa payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu || 107
                                ||
2.2.5. Persons Competent to Receive Vedic Instruction

āptaḥ śakto 'rthadaḥ sādhuḥ svo 'dhyāpyā daśa dharmataḥ ||
                                109 ||
na-apṛṣṭaḥ kasya cid brūyān na ca-anyāyena pṛcchataḥ |
jānann api hi medhāvī jaḍaval loka ācaret || 110 ||
adharmeṇa ca yaḥ prāha yaś ca-adharmeṇa pṛcchati |
dharma.arthau yatra na syātāṃ śuśrūṣā vā-api tadvidhā |
tatra vidyā na vaptavyā śubhaṃ bījam iva-ūṣare || 112 ||
āpady api hi ghorāyāṃ na tv enām iriṇe vapet || 113 ||
vidyā brāhmaṇam etya-āha śevadhis te 'smi rakṣa mām |
asūyakāya māṃ mādās tathā syāṃ vīryavattamā || 114 ||
yam eva tu śuciṃ vidyān niyata.brahmacāriṇam |
brahma yas tv ananujñātam adhīyānād avāpnuyāt |
laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ vā-api tathā-adhyātmikam eva vā |
ādadīta yato jñānaṃ taṃ pūrvam abhivādayet || 117 ||
ūrdhvaṃ prāṇā hy utkrāmanti yūnaḥ sthavira āyati |
catvāri tasya vardhante āyur dharmo yaśo balam || 121 ||
asau nāma-aham asmi-iti svaṃ nāma parikīrtayet || 122 ||
nāmadheyasya ye ke cid abhivādaṃ na jānate |

tān prājño 'ham iti brūyāt striyaḥ sarvās tathā-eva ca ||
                                123 ||

nāmnām svarūpa.bhāvo hi bho.bhāva ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 124
                                ||

a.kāraś ca-asya nāmno 'nte vācyaḥ pūrvākṣaraḥ plutaḥ || 125
                                ||
yo na vetty abhivādasya vipraḥ pratyabhivādanam |

na-abhivādyaḥ sa viduṣā yathā śūdras tathā-eva saḥ || 126
                                ||
vaiśyaṃ kṣemaṃ samāgamya śūdram ārogyam eva ca || 127 ||
a.vācyo dīkṣito nāmnā yavīyān api yo bhavet |
parapatnī tu yā strī syād a.sambandhā ca yonitaḥ |

tāṃ brūyād bhavati-ity evaṃ subhage bhagini-iti ca || 129
                                ||
mātulāṃś ca pitṛvyāṃś ca śvaśurān ṛtvijo gurūn |
asāv aham iti brūyāt pratyutthāya yavīyasaḥ || 130 ||
pitur bhaginyāṃ mātuś ca jyāyasyāṃ ca svasary api |
mātṛvad vṛttim ātiṣṭhen mātā tābhyo garīyasī || 133 ||
brāhmaṇaṃ daśavarṣaṃ tu śatavarṣaṃ tu bhūmipam |
pitā.putrau vijānīyād brāhmaṇas tu tayoḥ pitā || 135 ||
vittaṃ bandhur vayaḥ karma vidyā bhavati pañcamī |
etāni mānyasthānāni garīyo yad yad uttaram || 136 ||
pañcānāṃ triṣu varṇeṣu bhūyāṃsi guṇavanti ca |

yatra syuḥ so 'tra māna.arhaḥ śūdro 'pi daśamīṃ gataḥ || 137
                                ||
snātakasya ca rājñaś ca panthā deyo varasya ca || 138 ||
upanīya tu yaḥ śiṣyaṃ vedam adhyāpayed dvijaḥ |

sa.kalpaṃ sa.rahasyaṃ ca tam ācāryaṃ pracakṣate || 140
                                ||
ekadeśaṃ tu vedasya vedāṅgāny api vā punaḥ |
sambhāvayati ca-annena sa vipro gurur ucyate || 142 ||

yaḥ karoti vṛto yasya sa tasya-ṛtvig iha-ucyate || 143
                                ||
ya āvṛṇoty a.vitathaṃ brahmaṇā śravaṇāv ubhau |

sa mātā sa pitā jñeyas taṃ na druhyet kadā cana || 144
                                ||

brahmajanma hi viprasya pretya ca-iha ca śāśvatam || 146
                                ||
kāmān mātā pitā ca-enaṃ yad utpādayato mithaḥ |

sambhūtiṃ tasya tāṃ vidyād yad yonāv abhijāyate || 147
                                ||
ācāryas tv asya yāṃ jātiṃ vidhivad vedapāragaḥ |
alpaṃ vā bahu vā yasya śrutasya-upakaroti yaḥ |
brāhmasya janmanaḥ kartā svadharmasya ca śāsitā |

bālo 'pi vipro vṛddhasya pitā bhavati dharmataḥ || 150
                                ||
adhyāpayām āsa pitṝn śiśur āṅgirasaḥ kaviḥ |
putrakā iti ha-uvāca jñānena parigṛhya tān || 151 ||
te tam artham apṛcchanta devān āgata.manyavaḥ |

devāś ca-etān sametya-ūcur nyāyyaṃ vaḥ śiśur uktavān || 152
                                ||
ajño bhavati vai bālaḥ pitā bhavati mantradaḥ |

ajñaṃ hi bālam ity āhuḥ pitā-ity eva tu mantradam || 153
                                ||
na hāyanair na palitair na vittena na bandhubhiḥ |
ṛṣayaś cakrire dharmaṃ yo 'nūcānaḥ sa no mahān || 154 ||
viprāṇāṃ jñānato jyaiṣṭhyaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu vīryataḥ |
na tena vṛddho bhavati yenāsya palitaṃ śiraḥ |

yo vai yuvā-apy adhīyānas taṃ devāḥ sthaviraṃ viduḥ || 156
                                ||
yathā kāṣṭhamayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ |

yaś ca vipro 'n.adhīyānas trayas te nāma bibhrati || 157
                                ||

yathā ṣaṇḍho '.phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaur gavi ca-a.phalā
                                |

vāk ca-eva madhurā ślakṣṇā prayojyā dharmam icchatā || 159
                                ||
yasya vāc.manasī śuddhe samyaggupte ca sarvadā |
sa vai sarvam avāpnoti vedānta.upagataṃ phalam || 160 ||
sammānād brāhmaṇo nityam udvijeta viṣād iva |
sukhaṃ hy avamataḥ śete sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate |
vedam eva sadā-abhyasyet tapas tapsyan dvijottamaḥ |
vedābhyāso hi viprasya tapaḥ param iha-ucyate || 166 ||
ā ha-eva sa nakhāgrebhyaḥ paramaṃ tapyate tapaḥ |

yaḥ sragvy api dvijo 'dhīte svādhyāyaṃ śaktito 'nvaham ||
                                167 ||
yo 'n.adhītya dvijo vedam anyatra kurute śramam |

sa jīvann eva śūdratvam āśu gacchati sa.anvayaḥ || 168
                                ||
tatra-asya mātā sāvitrī pitā tv ācārya ucyate || 170 ||

na hy asmin yujyate karma kiñ cid ā mauñjibandhanāt || 171
                                ||
śūdreṇa hi samas tāvad yāvad vede na jāyate || 172 ||
yady asya vihitaṃ carma yat sūtraṃ yā ca mekhalā |

yo daṇḍo yat-ca vasanaṃ tat tad asya vrateṣv api || 174
                                ||
seveta-imāṃs tu niyamān brahmacārī gurau vasan |
varjayen madhu māṃsaṃ ca gandhaṃ mālyaṃ rasān striyaḥ |
śuktāni yāni sarvāṇi prāṇināṃ ca-eva hiṃsanam || 177 ||

kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca nartanaṃ gītavādanam || 178
                                ||
dyūtaṃ ca janavādaṃ ca parivādaṃ tathā-anṛtam |
strīṇāṃ ca prekṣaṇālambham upaghātaṃ parasya ca || 179 ||
ekaḥ śayīta sarvatra na retaḥ skandayet kva cit |

kāmādd hi skandayan reto hinasti vratam ātmanaḥ || 180
                                ||
svapne siktvā brahmacārī dvijaḥ śukram a.kāmataḥ |

snātvā-arkam arcayitvā triḥ punar mām ity ṛcaṃ japet || 181
                                ||

āhared yāvad arthāni bhaikṣaṃ ca-ahar.ahaś caret || 182
                                    ||
guroḥ kule na bhikṣeta na jñāti.kula.bandhuṣu |

a.lābhe tv anyagehānāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ vivarjayet || 184
                                    ||
sarvaṃ vāpi cared grāmaṃ pūrva.uktānām a.sambhave |

niyamya prayato vācam abhiśastāṃs tu varjayet || 185
                                    ||

sāyaṃ.prātaś ca juhuyāt tābhir agnim atandritaḥ || 186
                                    ||

bhaikṣeṇa vartayen nityaṃ na-ekānna.adī bhaved vratī
                                    |

kāmam abhyarthito 'śnīyād vratam asya na lupyate || 189
                                    ||

rājanya.vaiśyayos tv evaṃ na-etat karma vidhīyate || 190
                                    ||
codito guruṇā nityam a.pracodita eva vā |
kuryād adhyayane yatnam ācāryasya hiteṣu ca || 191 ||
śarīraṃ ca-eva vācaṃ ca buddhīndriya.manāṃsi ca |

niyamya prāñjalis tiṣṭhed vīkṣamāṇo guror mukham || 192
                                ||

āsyatām iti ca-uktaḥ sann āsīta-abhimukhaṃ guroḥ || 193
                                ||

uttiṣṭhet prathamaṃ cāsya caramaṃ ca-eva saṃviśet || 194
                                ||

na-āsīno na ca bhuñjāno na tiṣṭhan na parāṅ.mukhaḥ || 195
                                ||
āsīnasya sthitaḥ kuryād abhigacchaṃs tu tiṣṭhataḥ |

pratyudgamya tv āvrajataḥ paścād dhāvaṃs tu dhāvataḥ || 196
                                ||
praṇamya tu śayānasya nideśe ca-eva tiṣṭhataḥ || 197 ||
nīcaṃ śayyā.āsanaṃ ca.asya nityaṃ syād gurusannidhau |

guros tu cakṣurviṣaye na yathā.iṣṭa.āsano bhavet || 198
                                ||
na-udāhared asya nāma parokṣam api kevalam |
guror yatra parivādo nindā vā.api pravartate |

karṇau tatra pidhātavyau gantavyaṃ vā tato 'nyataḥ || 200
                                ||
parīvādāt kharo bhavati śvā vai bhavati nindakaḥ |
paribhoktā kṛmir bhavati kīṭo bhavati matsarī || 201 ||
dūrastho na-arcayed enaṃ na kruddho na-antike striyāḥ |

a.saṃśrave ca-eva guror na kiṃ cid api kīrtayet || 203
                                ||
guror gurau sannihite guruvad vṛttim ācaret |

na ca-a.nisṛṣṭo guruṇā svān gurūn abhivādayet || 205
                                    ||
vidyāguruṣv evam eva nityā vṛttiḥ svayoniṣu |
śreyaḥsu guruvad vṛttiṃ nityam eva samācaret |
bālaḥ samāna.janmā vā śiṣyo vā yajñakarmaṇi |
abhyañjanaṃ snāpanaṃ ca gātra.utsādanam eva ca |

gurupatnyā na kāryāṇi keśānāṃ ca prasādhanam || 211
                                    ||
svabhāva eṣa nārīṇāṃ narāṇām iha dūṣaṇam |
a.vidvāṃsam alaṃ loke vidvāṃsam api vā punaḥ |
mātrā svasrā duhitrā vā na viviktāsano bhavet |
kāmaṃ tu gurupatnīnāṃ yuvatīnāṃ yuvā bhuvi |

vidhivad vandanaṃ kuryād asāv aham iti bruvan || 216
                                    ||
yathā khanan khanitreṇa naro vāry adhigacchati |
muṇḍo vā jaṭilo vā syād atha vā syāt-śikhā.jaṭaḥ |

na-enaṃ grāme 'bhinimlocet sūryo na-abhyudiyāt kva cit ||
                                219 ||
taṃ ced abhyudiyāt sūryaḥ śayānaṃ kāmacārataḥ |

nimloced vā-apy a.vijñānāj japann upavased dinam || 220
                                ||
sūryeṇa hy abhinirmuktaḥ śayāno 'bhyuditaś ca yaḥ |
ācamya prayato nityam ubhe sandhye samāhitaḥ |
śucau deśe japañ japyam upāsīta yathāvidhi || 222 ||
yadi strī yady avarajaḥ śreyaḥ kiṃ cit samācaret |

tat sarvam ācared yukto yatra ca-asya ramen manaḥ || 223
                                ||
dharma.arthāv ucyate śreyaḥ kāma.arthau dharma eva ca |

artha eva-iha vā śreyas trivarga iti tu sthitiḥ || 224
                                ||
ācāryaś ca pitā ca-eva mātā bhrātā ca pūrvajaḥ |
ācāryo brahmaṇo mūrtiḥ pitā mūrtiḥ prajāpateḥ |

mātā pṛthivyā mūrtis tu bhrātā svo mūrtir ātmanaḥ || 226
                                    ||
yaṃ mātā.pitarau kleśaṃ sahete sambhave nṛṇām |

na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā kartuṃ varṣaśatair api || 227
                                    ||
tayor nityaṃ priyaṃ kuryād ācāryasya ca sarvadā |

teṣv eva triṣu tuṣṭeṣu tapaḥ sarvaṃ samāpyate || 228
                                    ||
teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ śuśrūṣā paramaṃ tapa ucyate |

na tair an.abhyanujñāto dharmam anyaṃ samācaret || 229
                                    ||
ta eva hi trayo lokās ta eva traya āśramāḥ |

ta eva hi trayo vedās ta eva-uktās trayo 'gnayaḥ || 230
                                    ||

pitā vai gārhapatyo 'gnir mātā-agnir dakṣiṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
                                    |
triṣv a.pramādyann eteṣu trīn lokān vijayed gṛhī |
imaṃ lokaṃ mātṛbhaktyā pitṛbhaktyā tu madhyamam |
sarve tasya-ādṛtā dharmā yasya-ete traya ādṛtāḥ |

an.ādṛtās tu yasya-ete sarvās tasya-a.phalāḥ kriyāḥ ||
                                    234 ||
yāvat trayas te jīveyus tāvat-na-anyaṃ samācaret |

teṣv eva nityaṃ śuśrūṣāṃ kuryāt priyahite rataḥ || 235
                                    ||
teṣām an.uparodhena pāratryaṃ yad yad ācaret |
triṣv eteṣv itikṛtyaṃ hi puruṣasya samāpyate |

eṣa dharmaḥ paraḥ sākṣād upadharmo 'nya ucyate || 237
                                    ||

anyād api paraṃ dharmaṃ strīratnaṃ duṣkulād api || 238
                                    ||
viṣād apy amṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ bālād api subhāṣitam |

amitrād api sadvṛttam amedhyād api kāñcanam || 239
                                    ||

striyo ratnāny atho vidyā dharmaḥ śaucaṃ subhāṣitam
                                    |

anuvrajyā ca śuśrūṣā yāvad adhyāyanaṃ guroḥ || 241
                                    ||
na-a.brāhmaṇe gurau śiṣyo vāsam ātyantikaṃ vaset |
yadi tv ātyantikaṃ vāsaṃ rocayeta guroḥ kule |
ā samāpteḥ śarīrasya yas tu śuśrūṣate gurum |

sa gacchaty añjasā vipro brahmaṇaḥ sadma śāśvatam || 244
                                ||
na pūrvaṃ gurave kiṃ cid upakurvīta dharmavit |

snāsyaṃs tu guruṇā-ājñaptaḥ śaktyā guru.artham āharet || 245
                                ||
kṣetraṃ hiraṇyaṃ gām aśvaṃ chatra.upānaham āsanam |
dhānyaṃ śākaṃ ca vāsāṃsi gurave prītim āvahet || 246 ||
dhānyaṃ vāsāṃsi śākaṃ vā gurave prītim āharan
ācārye tu khalu prete guruputre guṇānvite |
gurudāre sapiṇḍe vā guruvad vṛttim ācaret || 247 ||
evaṃ carati yo vipro brahmacaryam a.viplutaḥ |

sa gacchaty uttamasthānaṃ na ca-iha jāyate punaḥ || 249
                                ||
tadardhikaṃ pādikaṃ vā grahaṇāntikam eva vā || 1 ||
vedān adhītya vedau vā vedaṃ vā-api yathākramam |
sragviṇaṃ talpa āsīnam arhayet prathamaṃ gavā || 3 ||
a.sapiṇḍā ca yā mātur a.sagotrā ca yā pituḥ |
na-udvahet kapilāṃ kanyāṃ na-adhikāṅgīṃ na rogiṇīm |
na-a.lomikāṃ na-ati.lomāṃ na vācāṭāṃ na piṅgalām || 8 ||
yasyās tu na bhaved bhrātā na vijñāyeta vā pitā |
kāmatas tu pravṛttānām imāḥ syuḥ kramaśo 'varāḥ || 12 ||
śūdrā-eva bhāryā śūdrasya sā ca svā ca viśaḥ smṛte |

te ca svā ca-eva rājñaś ca tāś ca svā ca-agra.janmanaḥ || 13
                                ||
na brāhmaṇa.kṣatriyayor āpady api hi tiṣṭhatoḥ |

kasmiṃś cid api vṛttānte śūdrā bhāryā-upadiśyate || 14
                                    ||
kulāny eva nayanty āśu sa.santānāni śūdratām || 15 ||
śūdrāṃ śayanam āropya brāhmaṇo yāty adhogatim |
janayitvā sutaṃ tasyāṃ brāhmaṇyād eva hīyate || 17 ||

na-aśnanti pitṛ.devās tan na ca svargaṃ sa gacchati || 18
                                    ||

tasyāṃ ca-eva prasūtasya niṣkṛtir na vidhīyate || 19
                                    ||
caturṇām api varṇānaṃ pretya ca-iha hita.ahitān |
yo yasya dharmyo varṇasya guṇa.doṣau ca yasya yau |

tad vaḥ sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi prasave ca guṇa.aguṇān || 22

                                    |

                                    ca || 274 ||

                                    |

                                    || 275 ||

                                    tathā-itarāḥ || 276 ||

yukṣu kurvan dina.ṛkṣeṣu sarvān kāmān samaśnute
                                    |

                                    || 277 ||

                                    || 279 ||

yad eva tarpayaty adbhiḥ pitṝn snātvā dvijottamaḥ
                                    |

vasūn vadanti tu pitṝn rudrāṃś ca-eva pitāmahān
                                    |
caturtham āyuṣo bhāgam uṣitvā-ādyaṃ gurau dvijāḥ |
dvitīyam āyuṣo bhāgaṃ kṛta.dāro gṛhe vaset || 1 ||
yā vṛttis tāṃ samāsthāya vipro jīved anāpadi || 2 ||
ṛta.amṛtābhyāṃ jīvet tu mṛtena pramṛtena vā |
satya.anṛtābhyām api vā na śvavṛttyā kadā cana || 4 ||
ṛtam uñcha.śilaṃ jñeyam amṛtaṃ syād ayācitam |

mṛtaṃ tu yācitaṃ bhaikṣaṃ pramṛtaṃ karṣaṇaṃ smṛtam || 5
                                ||
satya.anṛtaṃ tu vāṇijyaṃ tena ca-eva-api jīvyate |
sevā śvavṛttir ākhyātā tasmāt tāṃ parivarjayet || 6 ||
kusūla.dhānyako vā syāt kumbhī.dhānyaka eva vā |
tryaha.ehiko vā-api bhaved a.śvastanika eva vā || 7 ||
jyāyān paraḥ paro jñeyo dharmato lokajittamaḥ || 8 ||
ṣaṭ.karma-eko bhavaty eṣāṃ tribhir anyaḥ pravartate |
dvābhyām ekaś caturthas tu brahmasattreṇa jīvati || 9 ||
na lokavṛttaṃ varteta vṛttihetoḥ kathaṃ cana |
santoṣaṃ param āsthāya sukhārthī saṃyato bhavet |
ato 'nyatamayā vṛttyā jīvaṃs tu snātako dvijaḥ |
veda.uditaṃ svakaṃ karma nityaṃ kuryād atandritaḥ |
tadd hi kurvan yathāśakti prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 14 ||
na vidyamāneṣv artheṣu na-ārtyām api yatas tataḥ || 15 ||

yathā tathā-adhyāpayaṃs tu sā hy asya kṛtakṛtyatā || 17
                                ||
buddhi.vṛddhi.karāṇy āśu dhanyāni ca hitāni ca |

nityaṃ śāstrāṇy avekṣeta nigamāṃś ca-eva vaidikān || 19
                                ||
yathā yathā hi puruṣaḥ śāstraṃ samadhigacchati |
tathā tathā vijānāti vijñānaṃ ca-asya rocate || 20 ||
nṛyajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ ca yathāśakti na hāpayet || 21 ||
vācy eke juhvati prāṇaṃ prāṇe vācaṃ ca sarvadā |
vāci prāṇe ca paśyanto yajñanirvṛttim akṣayām || 23 ||
jñānena-eva-apare viprā yajanty etair makhaiḥ sadā |
agnihotraṃ ca juhuyād ādi.ante dyu.niśoḥ sadā |
paśunā tv ayanasya-ādau samānte saumikair makhaiḥ || 26 ||
navānnam adyāt-māṃsaṃ vā dīrgham āyur jijīviṣuḥ || 27 ||

na-asya kaś cid vased gehe śaktito 'n.arcito 'tithiḥ || 29
                                ||
rājato dhanam anvicchet saṃsīdan snātakaḥ kṣudhā |

yājya.antevāsinor vā-api na tv anyata iti sthitiḥ || 33
                                ||
na sīdet snātako vipraḥ kṣudhā śaktaḥ kathaṃ cana |
na jīrṇa.malavad.vāsā bhavec ca vibhave sati || 34 ||

svādhyāye ca-eva yuktaḥ syān nityam ātmahiteṣu ca || 35
                                ||
vaiṇavīṃ dhārayed yaṣṭiṃ sa.udakaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum |
yajñopavītaṃ vedaṃ ca śubhaṃ raukme ca kuṇḍale || 36 ||
na-īkṣeta-udyantam ādityaṃ na-astaṃ yāntaṃ kadā cana |

na-upasṛṣṭaṃ na vāristhaṃ na madhyaṃ nabhaso gatam || 37
                                ||
na laṅghayed vatsatantrīṃ na pradhāvec ca varṣati |
na ca-udake nirīkṣeta svarūpam iti dhāraṇā || 38 ||
mṛdaṃ gāṃ daivataṃ vipraṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu catuṣpatham |
samānaśayane ca-eva na śayīta tayā saha || 40 ||
prajñā tejo balaṃ cakṣur āyuś ca-eva prahīyate || 41 ||
prajñā tejo balaṃ cakṣur āyuś ca-eva pravardhate || 42 ||
na-aśnīyād bhāryayā sārdhaṃ na-enām īkṣeta ca-aśnatīm |
kṣuvatīṃ jṛmbhamāṇāṃ vā na ca-āsīnāṃ yathāsukham || 43 ||
na-añjayantīṃ svake netre na ca-abhyaktām anāvṛtām |
na paśyet prasavantīṃ ca tejas.kāmo dvijottamaḥ || 44 ||
na-annam adyād ekavāsā na nagnaḥ snānam ācaret |
na mūtraṃ pathi kurvīta na bhasmani na govraje || 45 ||
na phālakṛṣṭe na jale na cityāṃ na ca parvate |
na jīrṇadevāyatane na valmīke kadā cana || 46 ||
na sa.sattveṣu garteṣu na gacchann api na sthitaḥ |
na nadītīram āsādya na ca parvatamastake || 47 ||
vāyu.agni.vipram ādityam apaḥ paśyaṃs tathā-eva gāḥ |
na kadā cana kurvīta viṣ.mūtrasya visarjanam || 48 ||

dakṣiṇā.abhimukho rātrau sandhyāyoś ca yathā divā ||
                                50 ||
chāyāyām andhakāre vā rātrāv ahani vā dvijaḥ |

prati.gu prati.vātaṃ ca prajñā naśyati mehataḥ || 52
                                ||
na-agniṃ mukhena-upadhamen nagnāṃ na-īkṣeta ca striyam |

na-amedhyaṃ prakṣiped agnau na ca pādau pratāpayet || 53
                                ||
adhastān na-upadadhyāc ca na ca-enam abhilaṅghayet |

na ca-enaṃ pādataḥ kuryān na prāṇa.ābādham ācaret || 54
                                ||
na-aśnīyāt sandhivelāyāṃ na gacchen na-api saṃviśet |

na ca-eva pralikhed bhūmiṃ na-ātmano 'paharet srajam || 55
                                ||
na-apsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā ṣṭhīvanaṃ vā samutsṛjet |
amedhyaliptam anyad vā lohitaṃ vā viṣāṇi vā || 56 ||
agnyagāre gavāṃ goṣṭhe brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sannidhau |
svādhyāye bhojane ca-eva dakṣinaṃ pāṇim uddharet || 58 ||
na vārayed gāṃ dhayantīṃ na ca-ācakṣīta kasya cit |

na divi-indrāyudhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kasya cid darśayed budhaḥ || 59
                                ||
na-adharmike vased grāme na vyādhi.bahule bhṛśam |

na-ekaḥ prapadyeta-adhvānaṃ na ciraṃ parvate vaset || 60
                                ||
na kurvīta vṛthāceṣṭāṃ na vāry añjalinā pibet |

na-utsaṅge bhakṣayed bhakṣyān na jātu syāt kutūhalī || 63
                                ||
na nṛtyed atha vā gāyen na vāditrāṇi vādayet |

na
                                    nṛtyen na-eva gāyec ca na vāditrāṇi vādayet
na-āsphoṭayen na ca kṣveḍen na ca rakto virāvayet || 64 ||
na pādau dhāvayet kāṃsye kadā cid api bhājane |
upānahau ca vāsaś ca dhṛtam anyair na dhārayet |
upavītam alaṅkāraṃ srajaṃ karakam eva ca || 66 ||
na-a.vinītair bhajed dhuryair na ca kṣudh.vyādhi.pīḍitaiḥ |
vinītais tu vrajen nityam āśugair lakṣaṇānvitaiḥ |
na chindyān nakha.romāṇi dantair na-utpāṭayen nakhān || 69 ||
na mṛt.loṣṭhaṃ ca mṛdnīyān na chindyāt karajais tṛṇam |

na karma niṣphalaṃ kuryān na-āyatyām a.sukha.udayam || 70
                                ||
loṣṭhamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ |
sa vināśaṃ vrajaty āśu sūcakā-aśucir eva ca || 71 ||
na vigarhya kathāṃ kuryād bahir mālyaṃ na dhārayet |
gavāṃ ca yānaṃ pṛṣṭhena sarvathā-eva vigarhitam || 72 ||
a.dvāreṇa ca na-atīyād grāmaṃ vā veśma vā-āvṛtam |
na-akṣair dīvyet kadā cit tu svayaṃ na-upānahau haret |
śayanastho na bhuñjīta na pāṇisthaṃ na ca-āsane || 74 ||
sarvaṃ ca tilasambaddhaṃ na-adyād astam ite ravau |

na ca nagnaḥ śayīta-iha na ca-ucchiṣṭaḥ kva cid vrajet || 75
                                ||
ārdra.pādas tu bhuñjīta na-ārdra.pādas tu saṃviśet |
ārdra.pādas tu bhuñjāno dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt || 76 ||
a.cakṣurviṣayaṃ durgaṃ na prapadyeta karhi cit |
na viṣ.mūtram udīkṣeta na bāhubhyāṃ nadīṃ taret || 77 ||
adhitiṣṭhen na keśāṃs tu na bhasma.asthi.kapālikāḥ |
na kārpāsa.asthi na tuṣān dīrgham āyur jijīviṣuḥ || 78 ||
na saṃvasec ca patitair na cāṇḍālair na pulkasaiḥ |

na mūrkhair na-avaliptaiś ca na-antyair na-antyāvasāyibhiḥ ||
                                79 ||
na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyān na-ucchiṣṭaṃ na haviṣkṛtam |

na ca-asya-upadiśed dharmaṃ na ca-asya vratam ādiśet || 80
                                ||
yo hy asya dharmam ācaṣṭe yaś ca-eva-ādiśati vratam |
so 'saṃvṛtaṃ nāma tamaḥ saha tena-eva majjati || 81 ||
na saṃhatābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyed ātmanaḥ śiraḥ |

na spṛśec ca-etad ucchiṣṭo na ca snāyād vinā tataḥ || 82
                                ||
keśagrahān prahārāṃś ca śirasy etān vivarjayet |

śiraḥsnātaś ca tailena na-aṅgaṃ kiṃ cid api spṛśet || 83
                                ||

tena tulyaḥ smṛto rājā ghoras tasya pratigrahaḥ || 86 ||

pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃs tiṣṭhet svakāle ca-aparāṃ ciram || 93
                                ||

puṣye tu chandasāṃ kuryād bahir utsarjanaṃ dvijaḥ |
yathāśāstraṃ tu kṛtvā-evam utsargaṃ chandasāṃ bahiḥ |
viramet pakṣiṇīṃ rātriṃ tad eva-ekam ahar.niśam || 97 ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ tu chandāṃsi śukleṣu niyataḥ paṭhet |

na niśānte pariśrānto brahma-adhītya punaḥ svapet || 99
                                ||

brahma chandaskṛtaṃ ca-eva dvijo yukto hy anāpadi || 100
                                ||
etāṃs tv abhyuditān vidyād yadā prāduṣkṛtāgniṣu |
etān ākālikān vidyād anadhyāyān ṛtāv api || 105 ||

sa.jyotiḥ syād anadhyāyaḥ śeṣe rātrau yathā divā || 106
                                ||
nitya.anadhyāya eva syād grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca |

ucchiṣṭaḥ śrāddhabhuk ca-eva manasā-api na cintayet || 109
                                ||

tryahaṃ na kīrtayed brahma rājño rāhoś ca sūtake || 110
                                ||
yāvad ekānudiṣṭasya gandho lepaś ca tiṣṭhati |
viprasya viduṣo dehe tāvad brahma na kīrtayet || 111 ||
nīhāre bāṇaśabde ca sandhyayor eva ca-ubhayoḥ |
amāvāsyā guruṃ hanti śiṣyaṃ hanti caturdaśī |

śva.khara.uṣṭre ca ruvati paṅktau ca na paṭhed dvijaḥ || 115
                                ||

vasitvā maithunaṃ vāsaḥ śrāddhikaṃ pratigṛhya ca || 116
                                ||
prāṇi vā yadi vā-aprāṇi yat kiṃ cit-śrāddhikaṃ bhavet |

tad ālabhya-apy anadhyāyaḥ pāṇy.āsyo hi dvijaḥ smṛtaḥ || 117
                                ||
aṣṭakāsu tv ahorātram ṛtvantāsu ca rātriṣu || 119 ||
na-adhīyīta-aśvam ārūḍho na vṛkṣaṃ na ca hastinam |

na nāvaṃ na kharaṃ na-uṣṭraṃ na-iriṇastho na yānagaḥ || 120
                                ||
na vivāde na kalahe na senāyāṃ na saṅgare |
na bhuktamātre na-ajīrṇe na vamitvā na śuktake || 121 ||
atithiṃ ca-an.anujñāpya mārute vāti vā bhṛśam |
rudhire ca srute gātrāt-śastreṇa ca parikṣate || 122 ||

vedasya-adhītya vā-apy antam āraṇyakam adhītya ca || 123
                                ||

sāmavedaḥ smṛtaḥ pitryas tasmāt tasya-aśucir dhvaniḥ || 124
                                ||
kramataḥ pūrvam abhyasya paścād vedam adhīyate || 125 ||
dvāv eva varjayen nityam anadhyāyau prayatnataḥ |

brahmacārī bhaven nityam apy ṛtau snātako dvijaḥ || 128
                                ||
na snānam ācared bhuktvā na-āturo na mahāniśi |

na-ākrāmet kāmataś chāyāṃ babhruṇo dīkṣitasya ca || 130
                                ||

madhyandine 'rdharātre ca śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā ca sa.āmiṣam
                                |

sandhyayor ubhayoś ca-eva na seveta catuṣpatham || 131
                                ||
udvartanam apasnānaṃ viṣ.mūtre raktam eva ca |
adhārmikaṃ taskaraṃ ca parasya-eva ca yoṣitaṃ || 133 ||
na hi-īdṛśam an.āyuṣyaṃ loke kiṃ cana vidyate |
kṣatriyaṃ ca-eva sarpaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ ca bahu.śrutam |
na-avamanyeta vai bhūṣṇuḥ kṛśān api kadā cana || 135 ||
etat trayaṃ hi puruṣaṃ nirdahed avamānitam |

tasmād etat trayaṃ nityaṃ na-avamanyeta buddhimān || 136
                                ||

ā mṛtyoḥ śriyam anvicchen na-enāṃ manyeta dur.labhām || 137
                                ||
satyaṃ brūyāt priyaṃ brūyān na brūyāt satyam apriyam |

priyaṃ ca na-anṛtaṃ brūyād eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 138
                                ||
bhadraṃ bhadram iti brūyād bhadram ity eva vā vadet |

śuṣka.vairaṃ vivādaṃ ca na kuryāt kena cit saha || 139
                                ||

na-ajñātena samaṃ gacchen na-eko na vṛṣalaiḥ saha || 140
                                ||
na ca-api paśyed aśuciḥ sustho jyotirgaṇān divā || 142 ||
spṛṣṭvā-etān aśucir nityam adbhiḥ prāṇān upaspṛśet |
gātrāṇi ca-eva sarvāṇi nābhiṃ pāṇitalena tu || 143 ||
an.āturaḥ svāni khāni na spṛśed animittataḥ |
romāṇi ca rahasyāni sarvāṇy eva vivarjayet || 144 ||

japec ca juhuyāc ca-eva nityam agnim atandritaḥ || 145
                                ||
japatāṃ juhvatāṃ ca-eva vinipāto na vidyate || 146 ||

taṃ hy asya-āhuḥ paraṃ dharmam upadharmo 'nya ucyate || 147
                                ||
adroheṇa ca bhūtānāṃ jātiṃ smarati paurvikīm || 148 ||

pitṝṃś ca-eva-aṣṭakāsv arcen nityam anvaṣṭakāsu ca || 150
                                ||
pūrvāhṇa eva kurvīta devatānāṃ ca pūjanam || 152 ||
daivatāny abhigacchet tu dhārmikāṃś ca dvijottamān |
īśvaraṃ ca-eva rakṣārthaṃ gurūn eva ca parvasu || 153 ||
abhivādayed vṛddhāṃś ca dadyāc ca-eva-āsanaṃ svakam |
ācārāt-labhate hy āyur ācārād īpsitāḥ prajāḥ |
ācārād dhanam akṣayyam ācāro hanty alakṣaṇam || 156 ||
dur.ācāro hi puruṣo loke bhavati ninditaḥ |

duḥkhabhāgī ca satataṃ vyādhito 'lpa.āyur eva ca || 157
                                ||
yad yat paravaśaṃ karma tat tad yatnena varjayet |

yad yad ātmavaśaṃ tu syāt tat tat seveta yatnataḥ || 159
                                ||
sarvaṃ paravaśaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvam ātmavaśaṃ sukham |
tat prayatnena kurvīta viparītaṃ tu varjayet || 161 ||
ācāryaṃ ca pravaktāraṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ gurum |

na hiṃsyād brāhmaṇān gāś ca sarvāṃś ca-eva tapasvinaḥ || 162
                                ||
nāstikyaṃ vedanindāṃ ca devatānāṃ ca kutsanam |

dveṣaṃ dambhaṃ ca mānaṃ ca krodhaṃ taikṣṇyaṃ ca varjayet ||
                                163 ||
parasya daṇḍaṃ na-udyacchet kruddho na-enaṃ nipātayet |

anyatra putrāt-śiṣyād vā śiṣṭi.arthaṃ tāḍayet tu tau || 164
                                ||
na kadā cid dvije tasmād vidvān avagured api |
na tāḍayet tṛṇena-api na gātrāt srāvayed asṛk || 169 ||
a.dhārmiko naro yo hi yasya ca-apy anṛtaṃ dhanam |
hiṃsārataś ca yo nityaṃ na-iha-asau sukham edhate || 170 ||
na sīdann api dharmeṇa mano 'dharme niveśayet |
na-adharmaś carito loke sadyaḥ phalati gaur iva |
śanair āvartyamānas tu kartur mūlāni kṛntati || 172 ||
yadi na-ātmani putreṣu na cet putreṣu naptṛṣu |

na tv eva tu kṛto 'dharmaḥ kartur bhavati niṣ.phalaḥ || 173
                                ||
tataḥ sapatnān jayati sa.mūlas tu vinaśyati || 174 ||

dharmaṃ ca-apy asukha.udarkaṃ lokasaṅkruṣṭam eva ca || 176
                                ||

na syād vāk.capalaś ca-eva na paradrohakarma.dhīḥ || 177
                                ||
yena-asya pitaro yātā yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ |

tena yāyāt satāṃ mārgaṃ tena gacchan na riṣyati || 178
                                ||
etair jitaiś ca jayati sarvān-lokān imān gṛhī || 181 ||

sambandhino hy apāṃ loke pṛthivyāṃ mātṛ.mātulau || 183
                                ||

bhrātā jyeṣṭhaḥ samaḥ pitrā bhāryā putraḥ svakā tanuḥ || 184
                                ||
chāyā svo dāsavargaś ca duhitā kṛpaṇaṃ param |

pratigraheṇa hy asya-āśu brāhmaṃ tejaḥ praśāmyati || 186
                                ||
na dravyāṇām a.vijñāya vidhiṃ dharmyaṃ pratigrahe |

prājñaḥ pratigrahaṃ kuryād avasīdann api kṣudhā || 187
                                ||
hiraṇyaṃ bhūmim aśvaṃ gām annaṃ vāsas tilān ghṛtam |
hiraṇyam āyur annaṃ ca bhūr gauś ca-apy oṣatas tanum |

aśvaś cakṣus tvacaṃ vāso ghṛtaṃ tejas tilāh prajāḥ || 189
                                ||
tasmād a.vidvān bibhiyād yasmāt tasmāt pratigrahāt |

svalpakena-apy a.vidvān hi paṅke gaur iva sīdati || 191
                                ||
na vāry api prayacchet tu baiḍālavratike dvije |
triṣv apy eteṣu dattaṃ hi vidhinā-apy arjitaṃ dhanam |
dātur bhavaty anarthāya paratra-ādātur eva ca || 193 ||
ye bakavratino viprā ye ca mārjāraliṅginaḥ |

te patanty andhatāmisre tena pāpena karmaṇā || 197
                                ||
na dharmasya-apadeśena pāpaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ caret |

chadmanā caritaṃ yac ca vrataṃ rakṣāṃsi gacchati ||
                                199 ||

sa liṅgināṃ haraty enas tiryagyonau ca jāyate || 200
                                ||
parakīyanipāneṣu na snāyādd hi kadā cana |
yamān seveta satataṃ na nityaṃ niyamān budhaḥ |

yamān pataty a.kurvāṇo niyamān kevalān bhajan || 204
                                ||

striyā klībena ca hute bhuñjīta brāhmaṇaḥ kva cit ||
                                205 ||
aślīkam etat sādhūnāṃ yatra juhvaty amī haviḥ |

pratīpam etad devānāṃ tasmāt tat parivarjayet || 206
                                ||
matta.kruddha.āturāṇāṃ ca na bhuñjīta kadā cana |

keśa.kīṭāvapannaṃ ca padā spṛṣṭaṃ ca kāmataḥ || 207
                                ||

patatriṇa.avalīḍhaṃ ca śunā saṃspṛṣṭam eva ca || 208
                                ||

gavā ca-annam upaghrātaṃ ghuṣṭānnaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
                                |

gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca viduṣā ca jugupsitam || 209
                                ||

śuktaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca-eva śūdrasya-ucchiṣṭam eva ca ||
                                211 ||
mṛṣyanti ye ca-upapatiṃ strījitānām ca sarvaśaḥ |

a.nirdaśaṃ ca pretānnam a.tuṣṭikaram eva ca || 217
                                ||
kārukānnaṃ prajāṃ hanti balaṃ nirṇejakasya ca |

pūyaṃ cikitsakasya-annaṃ puṃścalyās tv annam indriyam
                                |

ya ete 'nye tv abhojya.annāḥ kramaśaḥ parikīrtitāḥ
                                |

matyā bhuktvā-ācaret kṛcchraṃ retas.viṣ.mūtram eva ca
                                || 222 ||

tān prajāpatir āha-etya mā kṛdhvaṃ viṣamaṃ samam
                                |

śraddhayā-iṣṭaṃ ca pūrtaṃ ca nityaṃ kuryād atandritaḥ
                                |

śraddhākṛte hy akṣaye te bhavataḥ svāgatair dhanaiḥ
                                || 226 ||
yat kiṃ cid api dātavyaṃ yācitena-an.asūyayā |

utpatsyate hi tat pātraṃ yat tārayati sarvataḥ || 228
                                ||
vāridas tṛptim āpnoti sukham akṣayyam annadaḥ |

tilapradaḥ prajām iṣṭāṃ dīpadaś cakṣur uttamam || 229
                                ||
bhūmido bhūmim āpnoti dīrgham āyur hiraṇyadaḥ |

anaḍuhaḥ śriyaṃ puṣṭāṃ godo bradhnasya viṣṭapam ||
                                231 ||
yena yena tu bhāvena yad yad dānaṃ prayacchati |

tat tat tena-eva bhāvena prāpnoti pratipūjitaḥ || 234
                                ||
yo 'rcitaṃ pratigṛhṇāti dadāty arcitam eva vā |

tāv ubhau gacchataḥ svargaṃ narakaṃ tu viparyaye ||
                                235 ||
na vismayeta tapasā vaded iṣṭvā ca na-anṛtam |

na-ārto 'py apavaded viprān na dattvā parikīrtayet ||
                                236 ||
dharmaṃ śanaiḥ sañcinuyād valmīkam iva puttikāḥ |
na-amutra hi sahāyārthaṃ pitā mātā ca tiṣṭhataḥ |

na putradāraṃ na jñātir dharmas tiṣṭhati kevalaḥ ||
                                239 ||
ekaḥ prajāyate jantur eka eva pralīyate |

eko 'nubhuṅkte sukṛtam eka eva ca duṣkṛtam || 240
                                ||

vimukhā bāndhavā yānti dharmas tam anugacchati || 241
                                ||

tasmād dharmaṃ sahāyārthaṃ nityaṃ sañcinuyāt- śanaiḥ
                                |

dharmeṇa hi sahāyena tamas tarati dustaram || 242
                                ||
uttamair uttamair nityaṃ sambandhān ācaret saha |

ninīṣuḥ kulam utkarṣam adhamān adhamāṃs tyajet || 244
                                ||
uttamān uttamān eva gacchan hīnāṃs tu varjayan |

edha.udakaṃ mūla.phalam annam abhyudyataṃ ca yat
                                |
na-aśnanti pitaras tasya daśavarṣāṇi pañca ca |

na ca havyaṃ vahaty agnir yas tām abhyavamanyate ||
                                249 ||

śayyāṃ gṛhān kuśān gandhān apaḥ puṣpaṃ maṇīn dadhi
                                |

dhānā matsyān payo māṃsaṃ śākaṃ ca-eva na nirṇudet ||
                                250 ||

sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyān na tu tṛpyet svayaṃ tataḥ ||
                                251 ||
guruṣu tv abhyatīteṣu vinā vā tair gṛhe vasan |

ātmano vṛttim anvicchan gṛhṇīyāt sādhutaḥ sadā || 252
                                ||

ete śūdreṣu bhojya.annā yāś ca-ātmānaṃ nivedayet ||
                                253 ||
yādṛśo 'sya bhaved ātmā yādṛśaṃ ca cikīrṣitam |
yo 'nyathā santam ātmānam anyathā satsu bhāṣate |

vācy arthā niyatāḥ sarve vāc.mūlā vāc.viniḥsṛtāḥ
                                |

tāṃs tu yaḥ stenayed vācaṃ sa sarvasteyakṛt- naraḥ ||
                                256 ||

putre sarvaṃ samāsajya vasen mādhyasthyam āsśritaḥ ||
                                257 ||
ekākī cintayen nityaṃ vivikte hitam ātmanaḥ |
sa tān uvāca dharma.ātmā maharṣīn mānavo bhṛguḥ |
śrūyatāṃ yena doṣeṇa mṛtyur viprān jighāṃsati || 3 ||
ālasyād annadoṣāc ca mṛtyur viprāñ jighāṃsati || 4 ||
laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ ca-eva palāṇḍuṃ kavakāni ca |
śeluṃ gavyaṃ ca peyūṣaṃ prayatnena vivarjayet || 6 ||
a.nirdaśāyā goḥ kṣīram auṣṭram aikaśaphaṃ tathā |
āvikaṃ sandhinīkṣīraṃ vi.vatsāyāś ca goḥ payaḥ || 8 ||
āraṇyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ māhiṣaṃ vinā |
strīkṣīraṃ ca-eva varjyāni sarvaśuktāni ca-eva hi || 9 ||
dadhi bhakṣyaṃ ca śukteṣu sarvaṃ ca dadhi.sambhavam |
nimajjataś ca matsyādān saunaṃ vallūram eva ca || 13 ||
bakaṃ ca-eva balākāṃ ca kākolaṃ khañjarīṭakam |
matsyādān viḍvarāhāṃś ca matsyān eva ca sarvaśaḥ || 14 ||
yo yasya māṃsam aśnāti sa tanmāṃsāda ucyate |
rājīvān siṃhatuṇḍāś ca sa.śalkāś ca-eva sarvaśaḥ || 16 ||
na bhakṣayed ekacarān ajñātāṃś ca mṛga.dvijān |
bhakṣyeṣv api samuddiṣṭān sarvān pañcanakhāṃs tathā || 17 ||
palāṇḍuṃ gṛñjanaṃ ca-eva matyā jagdhvā pated dvijaḥ || 19 ||
a.matyā-etāni ṣaḍ jagdhvā kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret |
bhṛtyānāṃ ca-eva vṛtti.artham agastyo hy ācarat purā || 22 ||
yat kiṃ cit snehasaṃyuktaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyam a.garhitam |
tat paryuṣitam apy ādyaṃ haviḥśeṣaṃ ca yad bhavet || 24 ||
cirasthitam api tv ādyam a.snehāktaṃ dvijātibhiḥ |
prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayen māṃsaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kāmyayā |
yathāvidhi niyuktas tu prāṇānām eva ca-atyaye || 27 ||
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca-eva sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam || 28 ||
carāṇām annam a.carā daṃṣṭriṇām apy a.daṃṣṭriṇaḥ |
a.hastāś ca sa.hastānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ ca-eva bhīravaḥ || 29 ||
na-attā duṣyaty adann ādyān prāṇino 'hany.ahany api |
dhātrā-eva sṛṣṭā hy ādyāś ca prāṇino 'ttāra eva ca || 30 ||
yajñāya jagdhir māṃsasya-ity eṣa daivo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
ato 'nyathā pravṛttis tu rākṣaso vidhir ucyate || 31 ||
krītvā svayaṃ vā-apy utpādya para.upakṛtam eva vā |
devān pitṝṃś ca-arcayitvā khādan māṃsaṃ na duṣyati || 32 ||

jagdhvā hy a.vidhinā māṃsaṃ pretas tair adyate '.vaśaḥ || 33
                            ||
na tādṛśaṃ bhavaty eno mṛgahantur dhanārthinaḥ |
niyuktas tu yathānyāyaṃ yo māṃsaṃ na-atti mānavaḥ |
sa pretya paśutāṃ yāti sambhavān ekaviṃśatim || 35 ||
asaṃskṛtān paśūn mantrair na-adyād vipraḥ kadā cana |
mantrais tu saṃskṛtān adyāt-śāśvataṃ vidhim āsthitaḥ || 36 ||
kuryād ghṛtapaśuṃ saṅge kuryāt piṣṭapaśuṃ tathā |
na tv eva tu vṛthā hantuṃ paśum icchet kadā cana || 37 ||
yajñārthaṃ paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayam eva svayambhuvā |

yajño 'sya bhūtyai sarvasya tasmād yajñe vadho '.vadhaḥ || 39
                            ||
oṣadhyaḥ paśavo vṛkṣās tiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇas tathā |
yajñārthaṃ nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ prāpnuvanty utsṛtīḥ punaḥ || 40 ||
atra-eva paśavo hiṃsyā na-anyatra-ity abravīn manuḥ || 41 ||
eṣv artheṣu paśūn hiṃsan vedatattvārthavid dvijaḥ |
ātmānaṃ ca paśuṃ ca-eva gamayaty uttamaṃ gatim || 42 ||
gṛhe gurāv araṇye vā nivasann ātmavān dvijaḥ |
ahiṃsām eva tāṃ vidyād vedād dharmo hi nirbabhau || 44 ||
sa jīvāṃś ca mṛtaś ca-eva na kva cit sukham edhate || 45 ||
sa sarvasya hitaprepsuḥ sukham atyantam aśnute || 46 ||
yad dhyāyati yat kurute ratiṃ badhnāti yatra ca |
tad avāpnoty ayatnena yo hinasti na kiṃ cana || 47 ||
na-a.kṛtvā prāṇināṃ hiṃsāṃ māṃsam utpadyate kva cit |
na ca prāṇivadhaḥ svargyas tasmān māṃsaṃ vivarjayet || 48 ||
samutpattiṃ ca māṃsasya vadha.bandhau ca dehinām |
na bhakṣayati yo māṃsaṃ vidhiṃ hitvā piśācavat |
na loke priyatāṃ yāti vyādhibhiś ca na pīḍyate || 50 ||
saṃskartā ca-upahartā ca khādakaś ca-iti ghātakāḥ || 51 ||

an.abhyarcya pitṝn devāṃs tato 'nyo na-asty apuṇyakṛt || 52
                            ||
varṣe varṣe 'śvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ |
māṃsāni ca na khāded yas tayoḥ puṇyaphalaṃ samam || 53 ||
māṃ sa bhakṣayitā-amutra yasya māṃsam iha-admy aham |
na māṃsabhakṣaṇe doṣo na madye na ca maithune |
pravṛttir eṣā bhūtānāṃ nivṛttis tu mahāphalā || 56 ||

5.4.1. Death or Birth of a Person Belonging to the Same
                            Ancestry
aśuddhā bāndhavāḥ sarve sūtake ca tathā-ucyate || 58 ||
arvāk sañcayanād asthnāṃ tryaham ekāham eva vā || 59 ||
janane 'py evam eva syāt-nipuṇaṃ śuddhim icchatām || 61 ||
sarveṣāṃ śāvam āśaucaṃ mātā.pitros tu sūtakam |
janane 'py evam eva syān mātā.pitros tu sūtakam

sūtakaṃ mātur eva syād upaspṛśya pitā śuciḥ || 62
                                ||
ahnā ca-ekena rātryā ca trirātrair eva ca tribhiḥ |
guroḥ pretasya śiṣyas tu pitṛmedhaṃ samācaran |

rajasy uparate sādhvī snānena strī rajasvalā || 66
                                ||

araṇye kāṣṭhavat tyaktvā kṣapeyus tryaham eva tu || 69
                                ||

jāta.dantasya vā kuryur nāmni vā.api kṛte sati || 70
                                ||
a.kṣāra.lavaṇa.annāḥ syur nimajjeyuś ca te tryaham |

māṃsāśanaṃ ca na-aśnīyuḥ śayīraṃś ca pṛthak kṣitau ||
                                73 ||

sannidhāv eṣa vai kalpaḥ śāva.āśaucasya kīrtitaḥ
                                    |

vigataṃ tu videśasthaṃ śṛṇuyād yo hy a.nirdaśam
                                    |
atikrānte daśāhe ca trirātram aśucir bhavet |

nirdaśaṃ jñātimaraṇaṃ śrutvā putrasya janma ca
                                    |

sa.vāsā jalam āplutya śuddho bhavati mānavaḥ || 77
                                    ||

bāle deśāntarasthe ca pṛthak.piṇḍe ca saṃsthite
                                    |

sa.vāsā jalam āplutya sadya eva viśudhyati || 78
                                    ||

tāvat syād a.śucir vipro yāvat tat syād a.nirdaśam
                                    || 79 ||
trirātram āhur āśaucam ācārye saṃsthite sati |

tasya putre ca patnyāṃ ca divā.rātram iti sthitiḥ
                                    || 80 ||

prete rājani sa.jyotir yasya syād viṣaye sthitaḥ
                                    |

a.śrotriye tv ahaḥ kṛtsnam anūcāne tathā gurau ||
                                    82 ||
5.4.1.4. Periods of Impurity for Different Classes

na vardhayed agha.ahāni pratyūhen na-agniṣu kriyāḥ
                                    |

na ca tatkarma kurvāṇaḥ sa.nābhyo 'py aśucir bhavet
                                    || 84 ||
divākīrtim udakyāṃ ca patitaṃ sūtikāṃ tathā |

śavaṃ tatspṛṣṭinaṃ ca-eva spṛṣṭvā snānena śudhyati
                                    || 85 ||

saurān mantrān yathā.utsāhaṃ pāvamānīś ca śaktitaḥ
                                    || 86 ||

nāraṃ spṛṣṭvā-asthi sa.snehaṃ snātvā vipro
                                    viśudhyati |

ācamya-eva tu niḥsnehaṃ gām ālabhya-arkam īkṣya vā
                                    || 87 ||
ādiṣṭī na-udakaṃ kuryād ā vratasya samāpanāt |
pāṣaṇḍam āśritānāṃ ca carantīnāṃ ca kāmataḥ |
ācāryaṃ svam upādhyāyaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ gurum |

nirhṛtya tu vratī pretān na vratena viyujyate || 91
                                    ||

na rājñām aghadoṣo 'sti vratināṃ na ca sattriṇām
                                    |

aindraṃ sthānam upāsīnā brahmabhūtā hi te sadā ||
                                    93 ||

sadyaḥ santiṣṭhate yajñas tathā-āśaucam iti sthitiḥ
                                    || 98 ||

vipraḥ śudhyaty apaḥ spṛṣṭvā kṣatriyo
                                    vāhana.āyudham |

vaiśyaḥ pratodaṃ raśmīn vā yaṣṭiṃ śūdraḥ
                                    kṛta.kriyaḥ || 99 ||
5.4.2. Death of a Person Belonging to a Different Ancestry

asapiṇḍaṃ dvijaṃ pretaṃ vipro nirhṛtya bandhuvat
                                |

viśudhyati trirātreṇa mātur āptāṃś ca bāndhavān ||
                                101 ||
yady annam atti teṣāṃ tu daśāhena-eva śudhyati |

an.adann annam ahnā-eva na cet tasmin gṛhe vaset ||
                                102 ||
anugamya-icchayā pretaṃ jñātim ajñātim eva ca |

snātvā sa.cailaḥ spṛṣṭvā-agniṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya
                                viśudhyati || 103 ||
na vipraṃ sveṣu tiṣṭhatsu mṛtaṃ śūdreṇa nāyayet |
jñānaṃ tapo 'gnir āhāro mṛt-mano vāry upāñjanam |

vāyuḥ karma-arka.kālau ca śuddheḥ kartṝṇi dehinām ||
                                105 ||
sarveṣām eva śaucānām arthaśaucaṃ paraṃ smṛtaṃ |

yo 'rthe śucir hi sa śucir na mṛt.vāri.śuciḥ śuciḥ ||
                                106 ||

mṛt.toyaiḥ śudhyate śodhyaṃ nadī vegena śudhyati
                                |
adbhir gātrāṇi śudhyanti manaḥ satyena śudhyati |
eṣa śaucasya vaḥ proktaḥ śarīrasya vinirṇayaḥ |

bhasmanā-adbhir mṛdā ca-eva śuddhir uktā manīṣibhiḥ ||
                            111 ||
nirlepaṃ kāñcanaṃ bhāṇḍam adbhir eva viśudhyati |
apām agneś ca saṃyogādd haimaṃ raupyaṃ ca nirbabhau |
dravāṇāṃ ca-eva sarveṣāṃ śuddhir utpavanaṃ smṛtam |

prokṣaṇaṃ saṃhatānāṃ ca dāravāṇāṃ ca takṣaṇam || 115
                            ||

camasānāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca śuddhiḥ prakṣālanena tu || 116
                            ||
carūṇāṃ sruk.sruvāṇāṃ ca śuddhir uṣṇena vāriṇā |
adbhis tu prokṣaṇaṃ śaucaṃ bahūnāṃ dhānya.vāsasām |

prakṣālanena tv alpānām adbhiḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate || 118
                            ||
prokṣaṇāt tṛṇa.kāṣṭhaṃ ca palālaṃ ca-eva śudhyati |
madyair mūtraiḥ purīṣair vā ṣṭhīvanaih pūyaśoṇitaiḥ |
gavāṃ ca parivāsena bhūmiḥ śudhyati pañcabhiḥ || 124 ||

yāvat-na-apaity a.medhyāktād gandho lepaś ca tat.kṛtaḥ
                            |

a.dṛṣṭam adbhir nirṇiktaṃ yac ca vācā praśasyate || 127
                            ||

āpaḥ śuddhā bhūmigatā vaitṛṣṇyaṃ yāsu gor bhavet
                                |
nityaṃ śuddhaḥ kāru.hastaḥ paṇye yac ca prasāritam |

brahmacārigataṃ bhaikṣyaṃ nityaṃ medhyam iti sthitiḥ
                                || 129 ||
nityam āsyaṃ śuci strīṇāṃ śakuniḥ phalapātane |

prasrave ca śucir vatsaḥ śvā mṛgagrahaṇe śuciḥ || 130
                                ||

śvabhir hatasya yan māṃsaṃ śuci tan manur abravīt
                                |

kravyādbhiś ca hatasya-anyaiś caṇḍālādyaiś ca
                                dasyubhiḥ || 131 ||

ūrdhvaṃ nābher yāni khāni tāni medhyāni sarvaśaḥ
                                |

yāny adhas tāny a.medhyāni dehāc ca-eva malāś cyutāḥ
                                || 132 ||
makṣikā vipruṣaś chāyā gaur aśvaḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ |

rajo bhūr vāyur agniś ca sparśe medhyāni nirdiśet ||
                                133 ||

daihikānāṃ malānāṃ ca śuddhiṣu dvādaśasv api || 134
                            ||

śleśma aśru dūṣikā svedo dvādaśa-ete nṛṇāṃ malāḥ || 135
                            ||
ekā liṅge gude tisras tathā-ekatra kare daśa |

ubhayoḥ sapta dātavyā mṛdaḥ śuddhim abhīpsatā || 136
                            ||

triguṇaṃ syād vanasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ tu caturguṇam || 137
                            ||
kṛtvā mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā khāny ācānta upaspṛśet |

vedam adhyeṣyamāṇaś ca annam aśnaṃś ca sarvadā || 138
                            ||
trir ācāmed apaḥ pūrvaṃ dviḥ pramṛjyāt tato mukham |

śarīraṃ śaucam icchan hi strī śūdras tu sakṛt sakṛt ||
                            139 ||

na-ucchiṣṭaṃ kurvate mukhyā vipruṣo 'ṅgaṃ na yānti yāḥ
                            |

na śmaśrūṇi gatāny āsyaṃ na dantāntar.adhiṣṭhitam || 141
                            ||
spṛśanti bindavaḥ pādau ya ācāmayataḥ parān |

bhaumikais te samā jñeyā na tair āprayato bhavet || 142
                            ||
ucchiṣṭena tu saṃspṛṣṭo dravya.hastaḥ kathaṃ cana |

a.nidhāya-eva tad dravyam ācāntaḥ śucitām iyāt || 143
                            ||
vānto viriktaḥ snātvā tu ghṛtaprāśanam ācaret |

ācāmed eva bhuktvā-annaṃ snānaṃ maithuninaḥ smṛtam || 144
                            ||

suptvā kṣutvā ca bhuktvā ca niṣṭhīvya-uktvā-anṛtāni ca
                            |
eṣāṃ śaucavidhiḥ kṛtsno dravyaśuddhis tathā-eva ca |

ukto vaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ strīṇāṃ dharmān nibodhata || 146
                            ||
bālayā vā yuvatyā vā vṛddhayā vā-api yoṣitā |

na svātantryeṇa kartavyaṃ kiṃ cid kāryaṃ gṛheṣv api
                                || 147 ||
bālye pitur vaśe tiṣṭhet pāṇigrāhasya yauvane |

putrāṇāṃ bhartari prete na bhajet strī svatantratām
                                || 148 ||

pitrā bhartrā sutair vā-api na-icched viraham ātmanaḥ
                                |

eṣāṃ hi viraheṇa strī garhye kuryād ubhe kule || 149
                                ||
sadā prahṛṣṭayā bhāvyaṃ gṛhakārye ca dakṣayā |

yasmai dadyāt pitā tv enāṃ bhrātā vā-anumate pituḥ
                                |

taṃ śuśrūṣeta jīvantaṃ saṃsthitaṃ ca na laṅghayet ||
                                151 ||

sukhasya nityaṃ dātā-iha paraloke ca yoṣitaḥ || 153
                                ||
vi.śīlaḥ kāma.vṛtto vā guṇair vā parivarjitaḥ |

upacāryaḥ striyā sādhvyā satataṃ devavat patiḥ || 154
                                ||

na-asti strīṇāṃ pṛthag yajño na vrataṃ na-apy
                                upoṣaṇam |

patiṃ śuśrūṣate yena tena svarge mahīyate || 155
                                ||
pāṇigrāhasya sādhvī strī jīvato vā mṛtasya vā |

patilokam abhīpsantī na-ācaret kiṃ cid a.priyam ||
                                156 ||

kāmaṃ tu ksapayed dehaṃ puṣpa.mūla.phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ
                                |

na tu nāma-api gṛhṇīyāt patyau prete parasya tu ||
                                157 ||

yo dharma ekapatnīnāṃ kāṅkṣantī tam anuttamam || 158
                                ||

mṛte bhartari sāḍhvī strī brahmacarye vyavasthitā
                                |

svargaṃ gacchaty a.putrā-api yathā te brahmacāriṇaḥ
                                || 160 ||
apatyalobhād yā tu strī bhartāram ativartate |

sā-iha nindām avāpnoti paralokāc ca hīyate || 161
                                ||

na dvitīyaś ca sādhvīnāṃ kva cid bhartā-upadiśyate ||
                                162 ||
patiṃ hitvā-apakṛṣṭaṃ svam utkṛṣṭaṃ yā niṣevate |

nindyā-eva sā bhavel loke para.pūrvā-iti ca-ucyate ||
                                163 ||
vyabhicārāt tu bhartuḥ strī loke prāpnoti nindyatām |

sā bhartṛlokam āpnoti sadbhiḥ sādhvī-iti ca-ucyate ||
                                165 ||

iha-agryāṃ kīrtim āpnoti patilokaṃ paratra ca || 166
                                ||

evaṃ vṛttāṃ sa.varṇāṃ strīṃ dvijātiḥ pūrvamāriṇīm
                                |

punar dārakriyāṃ kuryāt punar ādhānam eva ca || 168
                                ||
anena vidhinā nityaṃ pañcayajñān na hāpayet |
dvitīyam āyuṣo bhāgaṃ kṛta.dāro gṛhe vaset || 169 ||
evaṃ gṛhāśrame sthitvā vidhivat snātako dvijaḥ |
vane vaset tu niyato yathāvad vijita.indriyaḥ || 1 ||
gṛhasthas tu yathā paśyed valī.palitam ātmanaḥ |
santyajya grāmyam āhāraṃ sarvaṃ ca-eva paricchadam |

putreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya vanaṃ gacchet saha-eva vā || 3
                                ||
vasīta carma cīraṃ vā sāyaṃ snāyāt prage tathā |
jaṭāś ca bibhṛyān nityaṃ śmaśru.loma.nakhāni ca || 6 ||
yad.bhakṣyaṃ syād tato dadyād baliṃ bhikṣāṃ ca śaktitaḥ |
svādhyāye nityayuktaḥ syād dānto maitraḥ samāhitaḥ |

darśam a.skandayan parva paurṇamāsaṃ ca yogataḥ || 9
                                    ||
turāyaṇaṃ ca kramaśo dakṣasyāyanam eva ca || 10 ||
devatābhyas tu tadd hutvā vanyaṃ medhyataraṃ haviḥ |
śeṣam ātmani yuñjīta lavaṇaṃ ca svayaṃ kṛtam || 12 ||
varjayen madhu māṃsaṃ ca bhaumāni kavakāni ca |
na phālakṛṣṭam aśnīyād utsṛṣṭam api kena cit |
na grāmajātāny ārto 'pi mūlāṇi ca phalāni ca || 16 ||
sadyaḥ prakṣālako vā syān māsa.sañcayiko 'pi vā |
ṣaṇmāsa.nicayo vā syāt samā.nicaya eva vā || 18 ||
naktaṃ ca-annaṃ samaśnīyād divā vā-āhṛtya śaktitaḥ |

caturthakāliko vā syāt syād vā-apy aṣṭama.kālikaḥ || 19
                                    ||

pakṣāntayor vā-apy aśnīyād yavāgūṃ kvathitāṃ sakṛt || 20
                                    ||
bhūmau viparivarteta tiṣṭhed vā prapadair dinam |
grīṣme pañca.tapās tu syād varṣāsv abhra.avakāśikaḥ |

ārdra.vāsās tu hemante kramaśo vardhayaṃs tapaḥ || 23
                                    ||
upaspṛśaṃs triṣavaṇaṃ pitṝn devāṃś ca tarpayet |
tāpaseṣv eva vipreṣu yātrikaṃ bhaikṣam āharet |
grāmād āhṛtya vā-aśnīyād aṣṭau grāsān vane vasan |
etāś ca-anyāś ca seveta dīkṣā vipro vane vasan |
ṛṣibhir brāhmaṇaiś ca-eva gṛhasthair eva sevitāḥ |
vaneṣu ca vihṛtya-evaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhāgam āyuṣaḥ |
caturtham āyuṣo bhāgaṃ tyakvā saṅgān parivrajet || 33 ||
ṛṇāni trīṇy apākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet |
an.apākṛtya mokṣaṃ tu sevamāno vrajaty adhaḥ || 35 ||
adhītya vidhivad vedān putrāṃś ca-utpādya dharmataḥ |
iṣṭvā ca śaktito yajñair mano mokṣe niveśayet || 36 ||
an.adhītya dvijo vedān an.utpādya tathā sutān |

an.iṣṭvā ca-eva yajñaiś ca mokṣam icchan vrajaty adhaḥ || 37
                                ||
ātmany agnīn samāropya brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajed gṛhāt || 38 ||
yo dattvā sarvabhūtebhyaḥ pravrajaty abhayaṃ gṛhāt |
yasmād aṇu-api bhūtānāṃ dvijān na-utpadyate bhayam |
tasya dehād vimuktasya bhayaṃ na-asti kutaś cana || 40 ||
eka eva caren nityaṃ siddhyartham asahāyavān |
siddhim ekasya sampaśyan na jahāti na hīyate || 42 ||
an.agnir a.niketaḥ syād grāmam annārtham āśrayet |
kālam eva pratīkṣeta nirveśaṃ bhṛtako yathā || 45 ||
dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyaset pādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet |
na ca-imaṃ deham āśritya vairaṃ kurvīta kena cit || 47 ||
kruddhyantaṃ na pratikrudhyed ākruṣṭaḥ kuśalaṃ vadet |
saptadvārāvakīrṇāṃ ca na vācam anṛtāṃ vadet || 48 ||
na tāpasair brāhmaṇair vā vayobhir api vā śvabhiḥ |
ataijasāni pātrāṇi tasya syur nir.vraṇāni ca |
teṣām adbhiḥ smṛtaṃ śaucaṃ camasānām iva-adhvare || 53 ||
alābuṃ dārupātraṃ ca mṛṇmayaṃ vaidalaṃ tathā |
ekakālaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ na prasajjeta vistare |
bhaikṣe prasakto hi yatir viṣayeṣv api sajjati || 55 ||
vṛtte śarāvasampāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ yatiś caret || 56 ||
alābhe na viṣadī syāt-lābhe ca-eva na harṣayet |
niraye ca-eva patanaṃ yātanāś ca yamakṣaye || 61 ||
viprayogaṃ priyaiś ca-eva saṃyogaṃ ca tathā-apriyaiḥ |
dehād utkramaṇaṃ ca-aṣmāt punar garbhe ca sambhavam |
deheṣu ca samutpattim uttameṣv adhameṣu ca || 65 ||
dūṣito 'pi cared dharmaṃ yatra tatra-āśrame rataḥ |

samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu na liṅgaṃ dharmakāraṇam || 66
                                    ||
na nāmagrahaṇād eva tasya vāri prasīdati || 67 ||
saṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ jantūnāṃ rātrāv ahani vā sadā |
ahnā rātryā ca yāñ jantūn hinasty ajñānato yatiḥ |

teṣāṃ snātvā viśuddhyarthaṃ prāṇāyāmān ṣaḍ ācaret || 69
                                    ||
dahyante dhmāyamānānāṃ dhātūnāṃ hi yathā malāḥ |
prāṇāyamair dahed doṣān dhāraṇābhiś ca kilbiṣam |
rajasvalam anityaṃ ca bhūtāvāsam imaṃ tyajet || 77 ||
nadīkūlaṃ yathā vṛkṣo vṛkṣaṃ vā śakunir yathā |

tathā tyajann imaṃ dehaṃ kṛcchrād grāhād vimucyate || 78
                                    ||
priyeṣu sveṣu sukṛtam apriyeṣu ca duṣkṛtam |

tadā sukham avāpnoti pretya ca-iha ca śāśvatam || 80
                                    ||
anena vidhinā sarvāṃs tyaktvā saṅgān-śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
dhyānikaṃ sarvam eva-etad yad etad abhiśabditam |

na hy an.adhyātmavit kaś cit kriyāphalam upāśnute || 82
                                    ||
adhiyajñaṃ brahma japed ādhidaivikam eva ca |

ādhyātmikaṃ ca satataṃ vedāntābhihitaṃ ca yat || 83
                                    ||
idaṃ śaraṇam ajñānām idam eva vijānatām |

idam anvicchatāṃ svargam idam ānantyam icchatām || 84
                                    ||
brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca vānaprastho yatis tathā |
sarve 'pi kramaśas tv ete yathāśāstraṃ niṣevitāḥ |

gṛhastha ucyate śreṣṭhaḥ sa trīn etān bibharti hi || 89
                                ||
yathā nadī.nadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃsthitim |
caturbhir api ca-eva-etair nityam āśramibhir dvijaiḥ |
dhīr vidyā satyam akrodho daśakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam || 92 ||
daśa lakṣaṇāni dharmasya ye viprāḥ samadhīyate |
adhītya ca-anuvartante te yānti paramāṃ gatim || 93 ||
niyato vedam abhyasya putraiśvarye sukhaṃ vaset || 95 ||
sambhavaś ca yathā tasya siddhiś ca paramā yathā || 1 ||
a.rājake hi loke 'smin sarvato vidruto bhayāt |
rakṣārtham asya sarvasya rājānam asṛjat prabhuḥ || 3 ||
yasmād eṣāṃ surendrāṇāṃ mātrābhyo nirmito nṛpaḥ |
tapaty ādityavac ca-eṣa cakṣūṃṣi ca manāṃsi ca |
na ca-enaṃ bhuvi śaknoti kaś cid apy abhivīkṣitum || 6 ||
so 'gnir bhavati vāyuś ca so 'rkaḥ somaḥ sa dharmarāṭ |
sa kuberaḥ sa varuṇaḥ sa mahendraḥ prabhāvataḥ || 7 ||
mahatī devatā hy eṣā nararūpeṇa tiṣṭhati || 8 ||
ekam eva dahaty agnir naraṃ durupasarpiṇam |
kāryaṃ so 'vekṣya śaktiṃ ca deśa.kālau ca tattvataḥ |
yasya prasāde padmā śrīr vijayaś ca parākrame |
mṛtyuś ca vasati krodhe sarvatejomayo hi saḥ || 11 ||
taṃ yas tu dveṣṭi sammohāt sa vinaśyaty asaṃśayam |
tasya hy āśu vināśāya rājā prakurute manaḥ || 12 ||
tasmād dharmaṃ yam iṣṭeṣu sa vyavasyen narādhipaḥ |
aniṣṭaṃ ca-apy aniṣṭeṣu taṃ dharmaṃ na vicālayet || 13 ||
tasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca |

bhayād bhogāya kalpante svadharmāt-na calanti ca || 15
                                    ||

taṃ deśa.kālau śaktiṃ ca vidyāṃ ca-avekṣya tattvataḥ
                                    |
sa rājā puruṣo daṇḍaḥ sa netā śāsitā ca saḥ |

caturṇām āśramāṇāṃ ca dharmasya pratibhūḥ smṛtaḥ || 17
                                    ||
daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā daṇḍa eva-abhirakṣati |

daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍaṃ dharmaṃ vidur budhāḥ || 18
                                    ||
samīkṣya sa dhṛtaḥ samyak sarvā rañjayati prajāḥ |
yadi na praṇayed rājā daṇḍaṃ daṇḍyeṣv atandritaḥ |
adyāt kākaḥ puroḍāśaṃ śvā ca lihyādd havis tathā |

svāmyaṃ ca na syāt kasmiṃś cit pravarteta-adhara.uttaram
                                    || 21 ||
sarvo daṇḍajito loko durlabho hi śucir naraḥ |

daṇḍasya hi bhayāt sarvaṃ jagad bhogāya kalpate || 22
                                    ||
yatra śyāmo lohita.akṣo daṇḍaś carati pāpahā |

prajās tatra na muhyanti netā cet sādhu paśyati || 25
                                    ||

dharmād vicalitaṃ hanti nṛpam eva sa.bāndhavam || 28
                                    ||
tato durgaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca lokaṃ ca sa.cara.acaram |

antarikṣagatāṃś ca-eva munīn devāṃś ca pīḍayet || 29
                                    ||
na śakyo nyāyato netuṃ saktena viṣayeṣu ca || 30 ||
svarāṣṭre nyāyavṛttaḥ syād bhṛśa.daṇḍaś ca śatruṣu |
sve sve dharme niviṣṭānāṃ sarveṣām anupūrvaśaḥ |
tena yad yat sa.bhṛtyena kartavyaṃ rakṣatā prajāḥ |

tat tad vo 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ || 36
                                    ||
traividyavṛddhān viduṣas tiṣṭhet teṣāṃ ca śāsane || 37 ||
vṛddhāṃś ca nityaṃ seveta viprān vedavidaḥ śucīn |
vṛddhasevī hi satataṃ rakṣobhir api pūjyate || 38 ||
vinīta.ātmā hi nṛpatir na vinaśyati karhi cit || 39 ||
sudāḥ paijavanaś ca-eva sumukho nimir eva ca || 41 ||
pṛthus tu vinayād rājyaṃ prāptavān manur eva ca |

kuberaś ca dhanaiśvaryaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ ca-eva gādhijaḥ || 42
                                ||
traividyebhyas trayīṃ vidyāṃ daṇḍanītiṃ ca śāśvatīm |
jita.indriyo hi śaknoti vaśe sthāpayituṃ prajāḥ || 44 ||
tauryatrikaṃ vṛthāṭyā ca kāmajo daśako gaṇaḥ || 47 ||
dvayor apy etayor mūlaṃ yaṃ sarve kavayo viduḥ |
taṃ yatnena jayet-lobhaṃ tajjāv etāv ubhau gaṇau || 49 ||
pānam akṣāḥ striyaś ca-eva mṛgayā ca yathākramam |
krodhaje 'pi gaṇe vidyāt kaṣṭam etat trikaṃ sadā || 51 ||
pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurutaraṃ vidyād vyasanam ātmavān || 52 ||
vyasanasya ca mṛtyoś ca vyasanaṃ kaṣṭam ucyate |

vyasany adho 'dho vrajati svar yāty avyasanī mṛtaḥ || 53
                                ||
sacivān sapta ca-aṣṭau vā prakurvīta parīkṣitān || 54 ||
api yat sukaraṃ karma tad apy ekena duṣkaram |
taiḥ sārdhaṃ cintayen nityaṃ sāmānyaṃ sandhi.vigraham |
teṣāṃ svaṃ svam abhiprāyam upalabhya pṛthak pṛthak |
samastānāṃ ca kāryeṣu vidadhyādd hitam ātmanaḥ || 57 ||
tena sārdhaṃ viniścitya tataḥ karma samārabhet || 59 ||
anyān api prakurvīta śucīn prājñān avasthitān |
teṣām arthe niyuñjīta śūrān dakṣān kula.udgatān |
vapuṣmān vītabhīr vāgmī dūto rājñaḥ praśasyate || 64 ||
amātye daṇḍa āyatto daṇḍe vainayikī kriyā |
dūta eva hi sandhatte bhinatty eva ca saṃhatān |
dūtas tat kurute karma bhidyante yena mānavaḥ || 66 ||
ākāram iṅgitaṃ ceṣṭāṃ bhṛtyeṣu ca cikīrṣitam || 67 ||
