dātavyaṃ sarvavarṇebhyo rājñā caurair hṛtaṃ dhanam |
svāni karmāṇi kurvāṇā dūre santo 'pi mānavāḥ |

priyā bhavanti lokasya sve sve karmaṇy avasthitāḥ || 42
                                    ||
na-utpādayet svayaṃ kāryaṃ rājā na-apy asya puruṣaḥ |
na ca prāpitam anyena grased arthaṃ kathaṃ cana || 43 ||
yathā nayaty asṛkpātair mṛgasya mṛgayuḥ padam |
satyam arthaṃ ca sampaśyed ātmānam atha sākṣiṇaḥ |

deśaṃ rūpaṃ ca kālaṃ ca vyavahāravidhau sthitaḥ || 45
                                    ||
sadbhir ācaritaṃ yat syād dhārmikaiś ca dvijātibhiḥ |
8.1.4. Grounds for Litigation-I Non-payment of Debts
yair yair upāyair arthaṃ svaṃ prāpnuyād uttamarṇikaḥ |
tair tair upāyaiḥ saṅgṛhya dāpayed adhamarṇikam || 48 ||
prayuktaṃ sādhayed arthaṃ pañcamena balena ca || 49 ||

na sa rājñā-abhiyoktavyaḥ svakaṃ saṃsādhayan dhanam || 50
                                ||
abhiyoktā diśed deśyaṃ karaṇaṃ vā-anyad uddiśet || 52 ||
adeśyaṃ yaś ca diśati nirdiśya-apahnute ca yaḥ |
apadiśya-apadeśyaṃ ca punar yas tv apadhāvati |

samyak praṇihitaṃ ca-arthaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ san na-abhinandati || 54
                                ||
a.sambhāṣye sākṣibhiś ca deśe sambhāṣate mithaḥ |

nirucyamānaṃ praśnaṃ ca na-icched yaś ca-api niṣpatet || 55
                                ||
brūhi-ity uktaś ca na brūyād uktaṃ ca na vibhāvayet |

na ca pūrva.aparaṃ vidyāt tasmād arthāt sa hīyate || 56
                                ||
sākṣiṇaḥ santi mety uktvā diśa-ity ukto diśen na yaḥ |
dharmasthaḥ kāraṇair etair hīnaṃ tam api nirdiśet || 57 ||
abhiyoktā na ced brūyād badhyo daṇḍyaś ca dharmataḥ |

na cet tripakṣāt prabrūyād dharmaṃ prati parājitaḥ || 58
                                ||
yo yāvat-nihnuvīta-arthaṃ mithyā yāvati vā vadet |

tau nṛpeṇa hy adharmajñau dāpyo taddviguṇaṃ damam || 59
                                ||
tādṛśān sampravakṣyāmi yathā vācyam ṛtaṃ ca taiḥ || 61 ||

arthyuktāḥ sākṣyam arhanti na ye ke cid anāpadi || 62
                                    ||
āptāḥ sarveṣu varṇeṣu kāryāḥ kāryeṣu sākṣiṇaḥ |
na-arthasambandhino na-āptā na sahāyā na vairiṇaḥ |

na dṛṣṭadoṣāḥ kartavyā na vyādhyārtā na dūṣitāḥ || 64
                                    ||
na sākṣī nṛpatiḥ kāryo na kāruka.kuśīlavau |

na śrotriyo na liṅgastho na saṅgebhyo vinirgataḥ || 65
                                    ||
na-adhyadhīno na vaktavyo na dasyur na vikarmakṛt |

na vṛddho na śiśur na-eko na-antyo na vikala.indriyaḥ ||
                                    66 ||

na-ārto na matto na-unmatto na kṣut.tṛṣṇā.upapīḍitaḥ
                                    |

na śramārto na kāmārto na kruddho na-api taskaraḥ || 67
                                    ||

strīṇāṃ sākṣyaṃ striyaḥ kuryur dvijānāṃ sadṛśā dvijāḥ
                                    |

śūdrāś ca santaḥ śūdrāṇām antyānām antya.yonayaḥ || 68
                                    ||
anubhāvī tu yaḥ kaś cit kuryāt sākṣyaṃ vivādinām |
striyā-apy asambhāve kāryaṃ bālena sthavireṇa vā |
śiṣyeṇa bandhunā vā-api dāsena bhṛtakena vā || 70 ||

vāg.daṇḍayoś ca pāruṣye na parīkṣeta sākṣiṇaḥ || 72
                                    ||

tatra satyaṃ bruvan sākṣī dharma.arthābhyāṃ na hīyate ||
                                    74 ||

avāṅ narakam abhyeti pretya svargāc ca hīyate || 75
                                    ||

pṛṣṭas tatra-api tad brūyād yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam || 76
                                    ||
eko 'lubdhas tu sākṣī syād bahvyaḥ śucyo 'pi na striyaḥ |

strībuddher asthiratvāt tu doṣaiś ca-anye 'pi ye vṛtāḥ ||
                                    77 ||
svabhāvena-eva yad brūyus tad grāhyaṃ vyāvahārikam |

ato yad anyad vibrūyur dharmārthaṃ tad apārthakam || 78
                                    ||

yad dvayor anayor vettha kārye 'smiṃś ceṣṭitaṃ mithaḥ
                                    |

tad brūta sarvaṃ satyena yuṣmākaṃ hy atra sākṣitā || 80
                                    ||
satyaṃ sākṣye bruvan sākṣī lokān āpnoty puṣkalān |

iha ca-an.uttamāṃ kīrtiṃ vāg eṣā brahmapūjitā || 81
                                    ||
sākṣye 'nṛtaṃ vadan pāśair badhyate vāruṇair bhṛśam |

vivaśaḥ śatam ājātīs tasmāt sākṣyaṃ vaded ṛtam || 82
                                    ||
satyena pūyate sākṣī dharmaḥ satyena vardhate |

tasmāt satyaṃ hi vaktavyaṃ sarvavarṇeṣu sākṣibhiḥ || 83
                                    ||
ātmā-eva hy ātmanaḥ sākṣī gatir ātmā tathā-ātmanaḥ |

mā-avamaṃsthāḥ svam ātmānaṃ nṛṇāṃ sākṣiṇam uttamam || 84
                                    ||
manyante vai pāpakṛto na kaś cit paśyati-iti naḥ |

rātriḥ sandhye ca dharmaś ca vṛttajñāḥ sarvadehinām || 86
                                    ||

udaṅ.mukhān prāṅ.mukhān vā pūrvāhṇe vai śuciḥ śucīn || 87
                                    ||

brūhi-iti brāhmaṇaṃ pṛcchet satyaṃ brūhi-iti pārthivam
                                    |

go.bīja.kāñcanair vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ sarvais tu pātakaiḥ ||
                                    88 ||
brahmaghno ye smṛtā lokā ye ca strī.bāla.ghātinaḥ |

mitradruhaḥ kṛta.ghnasya te te syur bruvato mṛṣā || 89
                                    ||
janmaprabhṛti yat kiṃ cit puṇyaṃ bhadra tvayā kṛtam |

tat te sarvaṃ śuno gacched yadi brūyās tvam anyathā || 90
                                    ||
eko 'ham asmi-ity ātmānaṃ yas tvaṃ kalyāṇa manyase |

nityaṃ sthitas te hṛdy eṣa puṇya.pāpa.īkṣitā muniḥ || 91
                                    ||
yamo vaivasvato devo yas tava-eṣa hṛdi sthitaḥ |

tena ced avivādas te mā gaṅgāṃ mā kurūn gamaḥ || 92
                                    ||
nagno muṇḍaḥ kapālena ca bhikṣārthī kṣut.pipāsitaḥ |

andhaḥ śatrukulaṃ gacched yaḥ sākṣyam anṛtaṃ vadet || 93
                                    ||
avāk.śirās tamasy andhe kilbiṣī narakaṃ vrajet |

yaḥ praśnaṃ vitathaṃ brūyāt pṛṣṭaḥ san dharmaniścaye ||
                                    94 ||
andho matsyān iva-aśnāti sa naraḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ saha |
yasya vidvān hi vadataḥ kṣetrajño na-abhiśaṅkate |

tasmān na devāḥ śreyāṃsaṃ loke 'nyaṃ puruṣaṃ viduḥ || 96
                                    ||
yāvato bāndhavān yasmin hanti sākṣye 'nṛtaṃ vadan |
pañca paśu.anṛte hanti daśa hanti gavānṛte |
hanti jātān ajātāṃś ca hiraṇyārthe 'nṛtaṃ vadan |

sarvaṃ bhūmi.anṛte hanti mā sma bhūmi.anṛtaṃ vadīḥ || 99
                                    ||
apsu bhūmivad ity āhuḥ strīṇāṃ bhoge ca maithune |

abjeṣu ca-eva ratneṣu sarveṣv aśmamayeṣu ca || 100
                                    ||
etān doṣān avekṣya tvaṃ sarvān anṛtabhāṣaṇe |

preṣyān vārdhuṣikāṃś ca-eva viprān śūdravad ācaret ||
                                    102 ||
tad vadan dharmato 'rtheṣu jānann apy anythā naraḥ |

na svargāc cyavate lokād daivīṃ vācaṃ vadanti tām || 103
                                    ||

tatra vaktavyam anṛtaṃ tadd hi satyād viśiṣyate || 104
                                    ||
vāc.daivatyaiś ca carubhir yajeraṃs te sarasvatīm |
kūṣmāṇḍair vā-api juhuyād ghṛtam agnau yathāvidhi |
ud ity ṛcā vā vāruṇyā tṛcena-ap.daivatena vā || 106 ||

tadṛṇaṃ prāpnuyāt sarvaṃ daśabandhaṃ ca sarvataḥ || 107
                                    ||

rogo 'gnir jñātimaraṇam ṛṇaṃ dāpyo damaṃ ca saḥ || 108
                                    ||
maharṣibhiś ca devaiś ca kāryārthaṃ śapathāḥ kṛtāḥ |

vasiṣṭhaś ca-api śapathaṃ śepe paijavane nṛpe || 110
                                    ||

na vṛthā śapathaṃ kuryāt svalpe 'py arthe naro budhaḥ
                                    |

vṛthā hi śapathaṃ kurvan pretya ca-iha ca naśyati || 111
                                    ||

go.bīja.kāñcanair vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ sarvais tu pātakaiḥ ||
                                    113 ||
agniṃ vā-āhārayed enam apsu ca-enaṃ nimajjayet |

putra.dārasya vā-apy enaṃ śirāṃsi sparśayet pṛthak ||
                                    114 ||
yam iddho na dahaty agnir āpo na-unmajjayanti ca |

na ca-ārtim ṛcchati kṣipraṃ sa jñeyaḥ śapathe śuciḥ ||
                                    115 ||
vatsasya hy abhiśastasya purā bhrātrā yavīyasā |

na-agnir dadāha roma-api satyena jagataḥ spaśaḥ || 116
                                    ||
yasmin yasmin vivāde tu kauṭasākṣyaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet |

tat tat kāryaṃ nivarteta kṛtaṃ ca-apy akṛtaṃ bhavet ||
                                    117 ||

lobhāt-mohād bhayāt-maitrāt kāmāt krodhāt tathā-eva ca
                                    |
eṣām anyatame sthāne yaḥ sākṣyam anṛtaṃ vadet |
lobhāt sahasraṃ daṇḍyas tu mohāt pūrvaṃ tu sāhasam |

bhayād dvau madhyamau daṇḍau maitrāt pūrvaṃ caturguṇam
                                    || 120 ||
kāmād daśaguṇaṃ pūrvaṃ krodhāt tu triguṇaṃ param |

ajñānād dve śate pūrṇe bāliśyāt-śatam eva tu || 121
                                    ||
etān āhuḥ kauṭasākṣye proktān daṇḍān manīṣibhiḥ |

kauṭasākṣyaṃ tu kurvāṇāṃs trīn varṇān dhārmiko nṛpaḥ
                                    |

triṣu varṇeṣu yāni syur akṣato brāhmaṇo vrajet || 124
                                    ||
upastham udaraṃ jihvā hastau pādau ca pañcamam |

cakṣur nāsā ca karṇau ca dhanaṃ dehas tathā-eva ca ||
                                    125 ||

asvargyaṃ ca paratra-api tasmāt tat parivarjayet || 127
                                    ||

adaṇḍyān daṇḍayan rājā daṇḍyāṃś ca-eva-apy adaṇḍayan
                                    |
ayaśo mahad āpnoti narakaṃ ca-eva gacchati || 128 ||

tṛtīyaṃ dhanadaṇḍaṃ tu vadhadaṇḍam ataḥ param || 129
                                    ||
vadhena-api yadā tv etān nigrahītuṃ na śaknuyāt |

tadā-eṣu sarvam apy etat prayuñjīta catuṣṭayam || 130
                                    ||
jālāntaragate bhānau yat sūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ |

tā rājasarṣapas tisras te trayo gaurasarṣapaḥ || 133
                                    ||
sarṣapāḥ ṣaḍ yavo madhyas triyavaṃ tv ekakṛṣṇalam |
pañcakṛṣṇalako māṣas te suvarṇas tu ṣoḍaśa || 134 ||
palaṃ suvarṇāś catvāraḥ palāni dharaṇaṃ daśa |
te ṣoḍaśa syād dharaṇaṃ purāṇaś ca-eva rājataḥ |

kārṣāpaṇas tu vijñeyas tāmrikaḥ kārṣikaḥ paṇaḥ || 136
                                    ||
dharaṇāni daśa jñeyaḥ śatamānas tu rājataḥ |
paṇānāṃ dve śate sārdhe prathamaḥ sāhasaḥ smṛtaḥ |

madhyamaḥ pañca vijñeyaḥ sahasraṃ tv eva ca-uttamaḥ ||
                                    138 ||
ṛṇe deye pratijñāte pañcakaṃ śatam arhati |
dvikaṃ śataṃ vā gṛhṇīyāt satāṃ dharmam anusmaran |

dvikaṃ śataṃ hi gṛhṇāno na bhavaty arthakilbiṣī || 141
                                    ||
dvikaṃ trikaṃ catuṣkaṃ ca pañcakaṃ ca śataṃ samam |

na tv eva-ādhau sa.upakāre kausīdīṃ vṛddhim āpnuyāt
                                    |
na bhoktavyo balād ādhir bhuñjāno vṛddhim utsṛjet |
ādhiś ca-upanidhiś ca-ubhau na kālātyayam arhataḥ |
samprītyā bhujyamānāni na naśyanti kadā cana |

dhenur uṣṭro vahann aśvo yaś ca damyaḥ prayujyate || 146
                                    ||
yat kiṃ cid daśavarṣāṇi sannidhau prekṣate dhanī |

bhujyamānaṃ parais tūṣṇīṃ na sa tat-labdhum arhati ||
                                    147 ||
ajaḍaś ced apogaṇḍo viṣaye ca-asya bhujyate |

bhagnaṃ tad vyavahāreṇa bhoktā tad dravyam arhati || 148
                                    ||

rājasvaṃ śrotriyasvaṃ ca na bhogena praṇaśyati || 149
                                    ||

dhānye sade lave vāhye na-atikrāmati pañcatām || 151
                                    ||

kusīdapatham āhus taṃ pañcakaṃ śatam arhati || 152
                                    ||
na-ati.sāṃvatsarīṃ vṛddhiṃ na ca-adṛṣṭāṃ punar haret |

cakravṛddhiḥ kālavṛddhiḥ kāritā kāyikā ca yā || 153
                                    ||
ṛṇaṃ dātum aśakto yaḥ kartum icchet punaḥ kriyām |

sa dattvā nirjitāṃ vṛddhiṃ karaṇaṃ parivartayet || 154
                                    ||

yāvatī sambhaved vṛddhis tāvatīṃ dātum arhati || 155
                                    ||

sthāpayanti tu yāṃ vṛddhiṃ sā tatra-adhigamaṃ prati ||
                                    157 ||
yo yasya pratibhūs tiṣṭhed darśanāya-iha mānavaḥ |

a.darśayan sa taṃ tasya prayacchet svadhanād ṛṇam || 158
                                    ||
prātibhāvyaṃ vṛthādānam ākṣikaṃ saurikāṃ ca yat |

daṇḍa.śulkāvaśeṣaṃ ca na putro dātum arhati || 159
                                    ||

paścāt pratibhuvi prete parīpset kena hetunā || 161
                                    ||
nirādiṣṭadhanaś cet tu pratibhūḥ syād alandhanaḥ |

svadhanād eva tad dadyān nirādiṣṭa iti sthitiḥ || 162
                                    ||
satyā na bhāṣā bhavati yady api syāt pratiṣṭhitā |

yatra vā-apy upadhiṃ paśyet tat sarvaṃ vinivartayet ||
                                    165 ||
grahītā yadi naṣṭaḥ syāt kuṭumbārthe kṛto vyayaḥ |

dātavyaṃ bāndhavais tat syāt pravibhaktair api svataḥ ||
                                    166 ||

svadeśe vā videśe vā taṃ jyāyān na vicālayet || 167
                                    ||

balād dattaṃ balād bhuktaṃ balād yac ca-api lekhitam
                                    |

sarvān balakṛtān arthān akṛtān manur abravīt || 168
                                    ||
trayaḥ parārthe kliśyanti sākṣiṇaḥ pratibhūḥ kulam |

catvāras tu-upacīyante vipra āḍhyo vaṇiṅ nṛpaḥ || 169
                                    ||

na ca-ādeyaṃ samṛddho 'pi sūkṣmam apy artham utsṛjet ||
                                    170 ||

daurbalyaṃ khyāpyate rājñaḥ sa pretya-iha ca naśyati ||
                                    171 ||
svādānād varṇasaṃsargāt tv abalānāṃ ca rakṣaṇāt |

balaṃ sañjāyate rājñaḥ sa pretya-iha ca vardhate || 172
                                    ||
tasmād yama iva svāmī svayaṃ hitvā priya.apriye |
yas tv adharmeṇa kāryāṇi mohāt kuryān narādhipaḥ |

acirāt taṃ dur.ātmānaṃ vaśe kurvanti śatravaḥ || 174
                                    ||

kāma.krodhau tu saṃyamya yo 'rthān dharmeṇa paśyati
                                    |

prajās tam anuvartante samudram iva sindhavaḥ || 175
                                    ||
yaḥ sādhayantaṃ chandena vedayed dhanikaṃ nṛpe |

sa rājñā tat-caturbhāgaṃ dāpyas tasya ca tad dhanam ||
                                    176 ||

samo 'vakṛṣṭajātis tu dadyāt-śreyāṃs tu tat- śanaiḥ ||
                                    177 ||
anena vidhinā rājā mitho vivadatāṃ nṛṇām |

mahāpakṣe dhaniny ārye nikṣepaṃ nikṣiped budhaḥ || 179
                                ||
yo yathā nikṣipedd haste yam arthaṃ yasya mānavaḥ |

sa tathā-eva grahītavyo yathā dāyas tathā grahaḥ || 180
                                ||
yo nikṣepaṃ yācyamāno nikṣeptur na prayacchati |

apadeśaiś ca sannyasya hiraṇyaṃ tasya tattvataḥ || 182
                                ||

na tatra vidyate kiṃ cid yat parair abhiyujyate || 183
                                ||
teṣāṃ na dadyād yadi tu tadd hiraṇyaṃ yathāvidhi |
ubhau nigṛhya dāpyaḥ syād iti dharmasya dhāraṇā || 184 ||
sa nigṛhya-ubhayaṃ dāpya iti dharmasya dhāraṇā
naśyato vinipāte tāv anipāte tv anāśinau || 185 ||
svayam eva tu yau dadyān mṛtasya pratyanantare |

na sa rājñā-abhiyoktavyo na nikṣeptuś ca bandhubhiḥ || 186
                                ||
vicārya tasya vā vṛttaṃ sāmnā-eva parisādhayet || 187 ||
nikṣepeṣv eṣu sarveṣu vidhiḥ syāt parisādhane |

sa.mudre na-āpnuyāt kiṃ cid yadi tasmān na saṃharet || 188
                                ||
caurair hṛtaṃ jalena-ūḍham agninā dagdham eva vā |
na dadyād yadi tasmāt sa na saṃharati kiṃ cana || 189 ||
yo nikṣepaṃ na-arpayati yaś ca-a.nikṣipya yācate |

tāv ubhau cauravat-śāsyau dāpyau vā tatsamaṃ damam || 191
                                ||
upadhābhiś ca yaḥ kaś cit paradravyaṃ haren naraḥ |

sa.sahāyaḥ sa hantavyaḥ prakāśaṃ vividhair vadhaiḥ || 193
                                ||
nikṣepo yaḥ kṛto yena yāvāṃś ca kulasannidhau |
tāvān eva sa vijñeyo vibruvan daṇḍam arhati || 194 ||
mitho dāyaḥ kṛto yena gṛhīto mitha eva vā |
mitha eva pradātavyo yathā dāyas tathā grahaḥ || 195 ||
8.1.6. Grounds for Litigation-III Sale Without Ownership
na taṃ nayeta sākṣyaṃ tu stenam astenamāninam || 197 ||
asvāminā kṛto yas tu dāyo vikraya eva vā |
akṛtaḥ sa tu vijñeyo vyavahāre yathā sthitiḥ || 199 ||
sambhogo dṛśyate yatra na dṛśyeta-āgamaḥ kva cit |
āgamaḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra na sambhoga iti sthitiḥ || 200 ||
vikrayād yo dhanaṃ kiṃ cid gṛhṇīyat kulasannidhau |
krayeṇa sa viśuddhaṃ hi nyāyato labhate dhanam || 201 ||
adaṇḍyo mucyate rājñā nāṣṭiko labhate dhanam || 202 ||
na ca-a.sāraṃ na ca nyūnaṃ na dūreṇa tirohitam || 203 ||
na sāvadyaṃ na ca nyūnaṃ na dūre na tirohitam
anyāṃ ced darśayitvā-anyā voḍhuḥ kanyā pradīyate |
ubhe ta ekaśulkena vahed ity abravīn manuḥ || 204 ||
na-unmattāyā na kuṣṭhinyā na ca yā spṛṣṭa.maithunā |

pūrvaṃ doṣān abhikhyāpya pradātā daṇḍam arhati || 205
                                    ||
ṛtvig yadi vṛto yajñe svakarma parihāpayet |

kṛtsnam eva labheta-aṃśam anyena-eva ca kārayet || 207
                                ||
yasmin karmaṇi yās tu syur uktāḥ pratyaṅgadakṣiṇāḥ |
sa eva tā ādidīta bhajeran sarva eva vā || 208 ||
rathaṃ haret ca-adhvaryur brahmā-ādhāne ca vājinam |

hotā vā-api hared aśvam udgātā ca-apy anaḥ kraye || 209
                                ||
sambhūya svāni karmāṇi kurvadbhir iha mānavaiḥ |
8.1.8. Grounds for Litigation-V Non-delivery of Gifts
dharmārthaṃ yena dattaṃ syāt kasmai cid yācate dhanam |

puruṣasya striyāś ca-eva dharme vartmani tiṣṭhatoḥ |

                                    |
viṣayeṣu ca sajjantyaḥ saṃsthāpyā ātmano vaśe || 2 ||
pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane |

rakṣanti sthavire putrā na strī svātantryam arhati || 3

kāle '.dātā pitā vācyo vācyaś ca-an.upayan patiḥ |
mṛte bhartari putras tu vācyo mātur arakṣitā || 4 ||

yatante rakṣituṃ bhāryāṃ bhartāro durbalā api || 6 ||
svāṃ prasūtiṃ caritraṃ ca kulam ātmānam eva ca |

svaṃ ca dharmaṃ prayatnena jāyāṃ rakṣan hi rakṣati || 7
                                    ||
patir bhāryāṃ sampraviśya garbho bhūtvā-iha jāyate |

                                    ||

etair upāyayogais tu śakyās tāḥ parirakṣitum || 10 ||
arthasya saṅgrahe ca-enāṃ vyaye ca-eva niyojayet |

ātmānam ātmanā yās tu rakṣeyus tāḥ surakṣitāḥ || 12
                                    ||
na-etā rūpaṃ parīkṣante na-āsāṃ vayasi saṃsthitiḥ |
surūpaṃ vā virūpaṃ vā pumān ity eva bhuñjate || 14 ||
pauṃścalyāc calacittāc ca naisnehyāc ca svabhāvataḥ |

paramaṃ yatnam ātiṣṭhet puruṣo rakṣaṇaṃ prati || 16
                                    ||
drohabhāvaṃ kucaryāṃ ca strībhyo manur akalpayat || 17 ||

na-asti strīṇāṃ kriyā mantrair iti dharme
                                    vyavasthitiḥ

nir.indriyā hy a.mantrāś ca strībhyo 'nṛtam iti sthitiḥ
                                    || 18 ||
tathā ca śrutayo bahvyo nigītā nigameṣv api |
yan me mātā pralulubhe vicaranty a.pativratā |

tan me retaḥ pitā vṛṅktām ity asya-etan nidarśanam || 20
                                    ||
dhyāyaty aniṣṭaṃ yat kiṃ cit pāṇigrāhasya cetasā |
9.1.1.2. Elevation of Wife to Husbands's Status

utkarṣaṃ yoṣitaḥ prāptāḥ svaiḥ svair bhartṛguṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ

                                    ||

                                    ||
vyabhicārāt tu bhartuḥ strī loke prāpnoti nindyatām |
putraṃ pratyuditaṃ sadbhiḥ pūrvajaiś ca maharṣibhiḥ |
bhartari putraṃ vijānanti śrutidvaidhaṃ tu kartari |
āhur utpādakaṃ ke cid apare kṣetriṇaṃ viduḥ || 32 ||
kṣetrabhūtā smṛtā nārī bījabhūtaḥ smṛtaḥ pumān |
viśiṣṭaṃ kutra cid bījaṃ strīyonis tv eva kutra cit |

ubhayaṃ tu samaṃ yatra sā prasūtiḥ praśasyate || 34
                                    ||
bījasya ca-eva yonyāś ca bījam utkṛṣṭam ucyate |

tādṛg rohati tat tasmin bījaṃ svair vyañjitaṃ guṇaiḥ ||
                                    36 ||
iyaṃ bhūmir hi bhūtānāṃ śāśvatī yonir ucyate |

na ca yoniguṇān kāṃś cid bījaṃ puṣyati puṣṭiṣu || 37
                                    ||
vrīhayaḥ śālayo mudgās tilā māṣās tathā yavāḥ |
anyad uptaṃ jātam anyad ity etat-na-upapadyate |

upyate yadd hi yad bījaṃ tat tad eva prarohati || 40
                                    ||
yathā bījaṃ na vaptavyaṃ puṃsā paraparigrahe || 42 ||
naśyati-iṣur yathā viddhaḥ khe viddham anuvidhyataḥ |
tathā naśyati vai kṣipraṃ bījaṃ paraparigrahe || 43 ||
pṛthor api-imāṃ pṛthivīṃ bhāryāṃ pūrvavido viduḥ |
etāvān eva puruṣo yat-jāyā-ātmā prajā-iti ha |

viprāḥ prāhus tathā ca-etad yo bhartā sā smṛta.aṅganā ||
                                    45 ||
sakṛd aṃśo nipatati sakṛt kanyā pradīyate |
sakṛd āha dadāni-iti trīṇy etāni satāṃ sakṛt || 47 ||

te vai sasyasya jātasya na labhante phalaṃ kva cit || 49
                                    ||

gominām eva te vatsā moghaṃ skanditam ārṣabham || 50
                                    ||

kurvanti kṣetriṇām arthaṃ na bījī labhate phalam || 51
                                    ||
phalaṃ tv an.abhisandhāya kṣetriṇāṃ bījinām tathā |

kriyābhyupagamāt tv etad bījārthaṃ yat pradīyate |

tasya-iha bhāginau dṛṣṭau bījī kṣetrika eva ca || 53
                                    ||

kṣetrikasya-eva tad bījaṃ na vaptā labhate phalam || 54
                                    ||

bhrātur jyeṣṭhasya bhāryā yā gurupatny anujasya sā |

                                    ||

                                    ||

avṛttikarśitā hi strī praduṣyet sthitimaty api || 74
                                    ||
vidhāya proṣite vṛttiṃ jīven niyamam āsthitā |

vidyārthaṃ ṣaḍ yaśo.'rthaṃ vā kāmārthaṃ trīṃs tu vatsarān

auraso vibhajan dāyaṃ pitryaṃ pañcamam eva vā || 164
                                    ||
svakṣetre saṃskṛtāyāṃ tu svayam utpādayedd hi yam |
yas talpajaḥ pramītasya klībasya vyādhitasya vā |

svadharmeṇa niyuktāyāṃ sa putraḥ kṣetrajaḥ smṛtaḥ || 167
                                    ||
mātā pitā vā dadyātāṃ yam adbhiḥ putram āpadi |

sadṛśaṃ prītisaṃyuktaṃ sa jñeyo dattrimaḥ sutaḥ || 168
                                    ||

putraṃ putraguṇair yuktaṃ sa vijñeyaś ca kṛtrimaḥ || 169
                                    ||
utpadyate gṛhe yas tu na ca jñāyeta kasya saḥ |

sa gṛhe gūḍha utpannas tasya syād yasya talpajaḥ || 170
                                    ||

yaṃ putraṃ parigṛhṇīyād apaviddhaḥ sa ucyate || 171
                                    ||
pitṛveśmani kanyā tu yaṃ putraṃ janayed rahaḥ |

taṃ kānīnaṃ vaden nāmnā voḍhuḥ kanyā.samudbhavam || 172
                                    ||
yā garbhiṇī saṃskriyate jñātā.ajñātā-api vā satī |

voḍhuḥ sa garbho bhavati sahoḍha iti ca-ucyate || 173
                                    ||

krīṇīyād yas tv apatyārthaṃ mātā.pitror yam antikāt
                                    |

sa krītakaḥ sutas tasya sadṛśo 'sadṛśo 'pi vā || 174
                                    ||
yā patyā vā parityaktā vidhavā vā svayā-icchayā |

utpādayet punar bhūtvā sa paunarbhava ucyate || 175
                                    ||
sā ced akṣata.yoniḥ syād gata.pratyāgatā-api vā |

paunarbhavena bhartrā sā punaḥ saṃskāram arhati || 176
                                    ||
mātā.pitṛ.vihīno yas tyakto vā syād akāraṇāt |

ātmānam arpayed yasmai svayandattas tu sa smṛtaḥ || 177
                                    ||
yaṃ brāhmaṇas tu śūdrāyāṃ kāmād utpādayet sutam |

sa pārayann eva śavas tasmāt pāraśavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 178
                                    ||
dāsyāṃ vā dāsadāsyāṃ vā yaḥ śūdrasya suto bhavet |

so 'nujñāto hared aṃśam iti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ || 179
                                    ||

yasya te bījato jātās tasya te na-itarasya tu || 181
                                    ||
bhrātṝṇām ekajātānām ekaś cet putravān bhavet |

sarvāṃs tāṃs tena putreṇa putriṇo manur abravīt || 182
                                    ||
sarvāsām eka.patnīnām ekā cet putriṇī bhavet |

sarvās tās tena putreṇa prāha putravatīr manuḥ || 183
                                    ||

bahavaś cet tu sadṛśāḥ sarve rikthasya bhāginaḥ || 184
                                    ||
na bhrātaro na pitaraḥ putrā rikthaharāḥ pituḥ |

pitā hared a.putrasya rikthaṃ bhrātara eva ca || 185
                                    ||
trayāṇām udakaṃ kāryaṃ triṣu piṇḍaḥ pravartate |
anantaraḥ sapiṇḍād yas tasya tasya dhanaṃ bhavet |

ata ūrdhvaṃ sakulyaḥ syād ācāryaḥ śiṣya eva vā || 187
                                    ||
sarveṣām apy abhāve tu brāhmaṇā rikthabhāginaḥ |

traividyāḥ śucayo dāntās tathā dharmo na hīyate || 188
                                    ||
a.hāryaṃ brāhmaṇadravyaṃ rājñā nityam iti sthitiḥ |

itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ sarva.abhāve haren nṛpaḥ || 189
                                    ||

tatra yad rikthajātaṃ syāt tat tasmin pratipādayet ||
                                    190 ||

dvau tu yau vivadeyātāṃ dvābhyāṃ jātau striyā dhane
                                    |

tayor yad yasya pitryaṃ syāt tat sa gṛhṇīta na-itaraḥ ||
                                    191 ||
jananyāṃ saṃsthitāyāṃ tu samaṃ sarve saha.udarāḥ |

bhajeran mātṛkaṃ rikthaṃ bhaginyaś ca sa.nābhayaḥ || 192
                                    ||
yās tāsāṃ syur duhitaras tāsām api yathārhataḥ |

mātāmahyā dhanāt kiṃ cit pradeyaṃ prītipūrvakam || 193
                                    ||
anvādheyaṃ ca yad dattaṃ patyā prītena ca-eva yat |

patyau jīvati vṛttāyāḥ prajāyās tad dhanaṃ bhavet || 195
                                    ||
a.prajāyām atītāyāṃ bhartur eva tad iṣyate || 196 ||

yat tv asyāḥ syād dhanaṃ dattaṃ vivāheṣv āsura.ādiṣu
                                    |

striyāṃ tu yad bhaved vittaṃ pitrā dattaṃ kathaṃ cana
                                    |

brāhmaṇī tadd haret kanyā tadapatyasya vā bhavet || 198
                                    ||
na nirhāraṃ striyaḥ kuryuḥ kuṭumbād bahumadhyagāt |

svakād api ca vittādd hi svasya bhartur anājñayā || 199
                                    ||
patyau jīvati yaḥ strībhir alaṅkāro dhṛto bhavet |

na taṃ bhajeran dāyādā bhajamānāḥ patanti te || 200
                                    ||

unmatta.jaḍa.mūkāś ca ye ca ke cin nir.indriyāḥ || 201
                                    ||
sarveṣām api tu nyāyyaṃ dātuṃ śaktyā manīṣiṇā |

grāsa.ācchādanam atyantaṃ patito hy a.dadad bhavet ||
                                    202 ||
yady arthitā tu dāraiḥ syāt klībādīnāṃ kathaṃ cana |

yat kiṃ cit pitari prete dhanaṃ jyeṣṭho 'dhigacchati
                                    |
a.vidyānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ īhātaś ced dhanaṃ bhavet |

samas tatra vibhāgaḥ syād apitrya iti dhāraṇā || 205
                                    ||

vidyādhanaṃ tu yady asya tat tasya-eva dhanaṃ bhavet
                                    |

maitryam audvāhikaṃ ca-eva mādhuparkikam eva ca || 206
                                    ||
bhrātṝṇāṃ yas tu na-īheta dhanaṃ śaktaḥ svakarmaṇā |

sa nirbhājyaḥ svakād aṃśāt kiṃ cid dattvā-upajīvanam ||
                                    207 ||

svayam īhitalabdhaṃ tan na-a.kāmo dātum arhati || 208
                                    ||
paitṛkaṃ tu pitā dravyam anavāptaṃ yad āpnuyāt |

na tat putrair bhajet sārdham a.kāmaḥ svayam arjitam ||
                                    209 ||
vibhaktāḥ saha jīvanto vibhajeran punar yadi |

samas tatra vibhāgaḥ syāj jyaiṣṭhyaṃ tatra na vidyate ||
                                    210 ||

mriyeta-anyataro vā-api tasya bhāgo na lupyate || 211
                                    ||
sodaryā vibhajeraṃs taṃ sametya sahitāḥ samam |

bhrātaro ye ca saṃsṛṣṭā bhāginyaś ca sa.nābhayaḥ || 212
                                    ||
yo jyeṣṭho vinikurvīta lobhād bhrātṝn yavīyasaḥ |

so 'jyeṣṭhaḥ syād a.bhāgaś ca niyantavyaś ca rājabhiḥ ||
                                    213 ||
sarva eva vikarmasthā na-arhanti bhrātaro dhanam |

na ca-a.dattvā kaniṣṭhebhyo jyeṣṭhaḥ kurvīta yautakam ||
                                    214 ||
bhrātṝṇām a.vibhaktānāṃ yady utthānaṃ bhavet saha |

na putrabhāgaṃ viṣamaṃ pitā dadyāt kathaṃ cana || 215
                                    ||
ūrdhvaṃ vibhāgāt-jātas tu pitryam eva hared dhanam |

saṃsṛṣṭās tena vā ye syur vibhajeta sa taiḥ saha || 216
                                    ||

mātary api ca vṛttāyāṃ pitur mātā hared dhanam || 217
                                    ||
ṛṇe dhane ca sarvasmin pravibhakte yathāvidhi |

paścād dṛśyeta yat kiṃ cit tat sarvaṃ samatāṃ nayet ||
                                    218 ||
vastraṃ patram alaṅkāraṃ kṛtānnam udakaṃ striyaḥ |

yogakṣemaṃ pracāraṃ ca na vibhājyaṃ pracakṣate || 219
                                    ||
ayam ukto vibhāgo vaḥ putrāṇāṃ ca kriyāvidhiḥ |
9.1.3. Grounds of Litigation-XVIII Gambling and Betting

tayor nityaṃ pratīghāte nṛpatir yatnavān bhavet || 222
                                ||
aprāṇibhir yat kriyate tat-loke dyūtam ucyate |

prāṇibhiḥ kriyate yas tu sa vijñeyaḥ samāhvayaḥ || 223
                                ||
dyūtaṃ samāhvayaṃ ca-eva yaḥ kuryāt kārayeta vā |

tān sarvān ghātayed rājā śūdrāṃś ca dvijaliṅginaḥ || 224
                                ||
kitavān kuśīlavān krūrān pāṣaṇḍasthāṃś ca mānavān |

vikarmasthān śauṇḍikāṃś ca kṣipraṃ nirvāsayet purāt || 225
                                ||
dyūtam etat purā kalpe dṛṣṭaṃ vairakaraṃ mahat |

tasmād dyūtaṃ na seveta hāsyārtham api buddhimān || 227
                                ||
pracchannaṃ vā prakāśaṃ vā tat-niṣeveta yo naraḥ |

tasya daṇḍavikalpaḥ syād yathā.iṣṭaṃ nṛpates tathā || 228
                                ||

ānṛṇyaṃ karmaṇā gacched vipro dadyāt-śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 229
                                ||
ye niyuktās tu kāryeṣu hanyuḥ kāryāṇi kāryiṇām |

dhana.uṣmaṇā pacyamānās tān niḥ.svān kārayen nṛpaḥ || 231
                                ||
tīritaṃ ca-anuśiṣṭaṃ ca yatra kva cana yad bhavet |

kṛtaṃ tad dharmato vidyāt-na tad bhūyo nivartayet || 233
                                ||
amātyāḥ prāḍvivāko vā yat kuryuḥ kāryam anyathā |
tat svayaṃ nṛpatiḥ kuryāt tān sahasraṃ ca daṇḍayet || 234 ||
9.1.4.1. Grievous Sins Causing Loss of Caste
brahmahā ca surāpaś ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ |
ete sarve pṛthag jñeyā mahāpātakino narāḥ || 235 ||

steye ca śvapadaṃ kāryaṃ brahmahaṇy a.śirāḥ pumān || 237
                                    ||

na-aṅkyā rājñā lalāṭe syur dāpyās tu-uttamasāhasam ||
                                    240 ||

vivāsyo vā bhaved rāṣṭrāt sa.dravyaḥ sa.paricchadaḥ ||
                                    241 ||
itare kṛtavantas tu pāpāny etāny akāmataḥ |
ādadānas tu tat-lobhāt tena doṣeṇa lipyate || 243 ||
īśo daṇḍasya varuṇo rājñāṃ daṇḍadharo hi saḥ |
niṣpadyante ca sasyāni yathā.uptāni viśāṃ pṛthak |

bālāś ca na pramīyante vikṛtaṃ ca na jāyate || 247
                                    ||
yāvān a.vadhyasya vadhe tāvān vadhyasya mokṣaṇe |

adharmo nṛpater dṛṣṭo dharmas tu viniyacchataḥ || 249
                                    ||
evaṃ dharmyāṇi kāryāṇi samyak kurvan mahīpatiḥ |
a.śāsaṃs taskarān yas tu baliṃ gṛhṇāti pārthivaḥ |

tasya prakṣubhyate rāṣṭraṃ svargāc ca parihīyate || 254
                                ||
nirbhayaṃ tu bhaved yasya rāṣṭraṃ bāhu.balāśritam |
tasya tad vardhate nityaṃ sicyamāna iva drumaḥ || 255 ||
teṣāṃ doṣān abhikhyāpya sve sve karmaṇi tattvataḥ |
na hi daṇḍād ṛte śakyaḥ kartuṃ pāpa.vinigrahaḥ |
śūnyāni ca-apy agārāṇi vanāny upavanāni ca || 265 ||
ye tatra na-upasarpeyur mūlapraṇihitāś ca ye |
na ha-ūḍhena vinā cauraṃ ghātayed dhārmiko nṛpaḥ |
grāmeṣv api ca ye ke cic caurāṇāṃ bhaktadāyakāḥ |

bhāṇḍa.avakāśadāś ca-eva sarvāṃs tān api ghātayet || 271
                                ||

abhyāghāteṣu madhyasthāñ śiṣyāc caurān iva drutam || 272
                                ||

daṇḍena-eva tam apy oṣet svakād dharmādd hi vicyutam || 273
                                ||
rājñaḥ kośāpahartṝṃś ca pratikūleṣu ca sthitān |
sandhiṃ chittvā tu ye cauryaṃ rātrau kurvanti taskarāḥ |

teṣāṃ chittvā nṛpo hastau tīkṣṇe śūle niveśayet || 276
                                ||

sannidhātṝṃś ca moṣasya hanyāc cauram iva-īśvaraḥ || 278
                                ||

āgamaṃ vā-apy apāṃ bhindyāt sa dāpyaḥ pūrvasāhasam || 281
                                ||
samutsṛjed rājamārge yas tv amedhyam anāpadi |

sa dvau kārṣāpaṇau dadyād amedhyaṃ ca-āśu śodhayet || 282
                                ||
āpadgato 'tha vā vṛddhā garbhiṇī bāla eva vā |

paribhāṣaṇam arhanti tac ca śodhyam iti sthitiḥ || 283
                                ||

pratikuryāc ca tat sarvaṃ pañca dadyāt-śatāni ca || 285
                                ||
samair hi viṣamaṃ yas tu cared vai mūlyato 'pi vā |
samāpnuyād damaṃ pūrvaṃ naro madhyamam eva vā || 287 ||
bandhanāni ca sarvāṇi rājā mārge niveśayet |
prākārasya ca bhettāraṃ parikhāṇāṃ ca pūrakam |

dvārāṇāṃ ca-eva bhaṅktāraṃ kṣipram eva pravāsayet || 289
                                ||
kālam āsādya kāryaṃ ca rājā daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet || 293 ||

svāmy.amātyau puraṃ rāṣṭraṃ kośa.daṇḍau suhṛt tathā
                                    |

sapta prakṛtayo hy etāḥ saptāṅgaṃ rājyam ucyate || 294
                                    ||

pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurutaraṃ jānīyād vyasanaṃ mahat || 295
                                    ||
teṣu teṣu tu kṛtyeṣu tat tad aṅgaṃ viśiṣyate |

yena yat sādhyate kāryaṃ tat tasmin-śreṣṭham ucyate ||
                                    297 ||
pīḍanāni ca sarvāṇi vyasanāni tathā-eva ca |
ārabheta-eva karmāṇi śrāntaḥ śrāntaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |

karmāṇy ārabhamāṇaṃ hi puruṣaṃ śrīr niṣevate || 300
                                    ||
kṛtaṃ tretāyugaṃ ca-eva dvāparaṃ kalir eva ca |
rājño vṛttāni sarvāṇi rājā hi yugam ucyate || 301 ||
kaliḥ prasupto bhavati sa jāgrad dvāparaṃ yugam |

karmasv abhyudyatas tretā vicaraṃs tu kṛtaṃ yugam || 302
                                    ||
indrasya-arkasya vāyoś ca yamasya varuṇasya ca |

candrasya-agneḥ pṛthivyāś ca tejovṛttaṃ nṛpaś caret ||
                                    303 ||

tathā-abhivarṣet svaṃ rāṣṭraṃ kāmair indravrataṃ caran
                                    || 304 ||
aṣṭau māsān yathā-ādityas toyaṃ harati raśmibhiḥ |

tathā haret karaṃ rāṣṭrāt-nityam arkavrataṃ hi tat ||
                                    305 ||

tathā cāraiḥ praveṣṭavyaṃ vratam etadd hi mārutam || 306
                                    ||
yathā yamaḥ priya.dveṣyau prāpte kāle niyacchati |

tathā rājñā niyantavyāḥ prajās tadd hi yamavratam || 307
                                    ||

tathā pāpān nigṛhṇīyād vratam etadd hi vāruṇam || 308
                                    ||
paripūrṇaṃ yathā candraṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyanti mānavāḥ |

tathā prakṛtayo yasmin sa cāndravratiko nṛpaḥ || 309
                                    ||

duṣṭasāmantahiṃsraś ca tad āgneyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam || 310
                                    ||
yathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni dharā dhārayate samam |

tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni bibhrataḥ pārthivaṃ vratam || 311
                                    ||
etair upāyair anyaiś ca yukto nityam atandritaḥ |

stenān rājā nigṛhṇīyāt svarāṣṭre para eva ca || 312
                                    ||
parām apy āpadaṃ prāpto brāhmaṇān na prakopayet |

te hy enaṃ kupitā hanyuḥ sadyaḥ sa.bala.vāhanam || 313
                                    ||
yaiḥ kṛtaḥ sarvabhakṣyo 'gnir apeyaś ca mahodadhiḥ |

kṣayī ca-āpyāyitaḥ somaḥ ko na naśyet prakopya tān ||
                                    314 ||
lokān anyān sṛjeyur ye lokapālāṃś ca kopitāḥ |

devān kuryur adevāṃś ca kaḥ kṣiṇvaṃs tān samṛdhnuyāt ||
                                    315 ||
yān upāśritya tiṣṭhanti lokā devāś ca sarvadā |

brahma ca-eva dhanaṃ yeṣāṃ ko hiṃsyāt tāñ jijīviṣuḥ ||
                                    316 ||

a.vidvāṃś ca-eva vidvāṃś ca brāhmaṇo daivataṃ mahat
                                    |

praṇītaś ca-a.praṇītaś ca yathā-agnir daivataṃ mahat ||
                                    317 ||
śmaśāneṣv api tejasvī pāvako na-eva duṣyati |
evaṃ yady apy aniṣṭeṣu vartante sarvakarmasu |

sarvathā brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ paramaṃ daivatam hi tat || 319
                                    ||

brahma-eva sanniyantṛ syāt kṣatraṃ hi brahma.sambhavam
                                    || 320 ||

adbhyo 'gnir brahmataḥ kṣatram aśmano loham utthitam
                                    |

teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati || 321
                                    ||

na-a.brahma kṣatram ṛdhnoti na-a.kṣatraṃ brahma vardhate
                                    |

brahma kṣatraṃ ca sampṛktam iha ca-amutra vardhate ||
                                    322 ||
putre rājyaṃ samāsṛjya kurvīta prāyaṇaṃ raṇe || 323 ||
9.1.7. Conclusion of the Rules for Kings
evaṃ caran sadā yukto rājadharmeṣu pārthivaḥ |
hiteṣu ca-eva lokasya sarvān bhṛtyān niyojayet || 324 ||
9.2. Rules of Action for Vaiśyas and Śūdras

vārtāyāṃ nityayuktaḥ syāt paśūnāṃ ca-eva rakṣaṇe || 326
                                ||
prajāpatir hi vaiśyāya sṛṣṭvā paridade paśūn |
brāhmaṇāya ca rājñe ca sarvāḥ paridade prajāḥ || 327 ||
na ca vaiśyasya kāmaḥ syān na rakṣeyaṃ paśūn iti |

vaiśye ca-icchati na-anyena rakṣitavyāḥ kathaṃ cana || 328
                                ||

gandhānāṃ ca rasānāṃ ca vidyād argha.bala.abalam || 329
                                ||
mānayogaṃ ca jānīyāt tulāyogāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ || 330 ||
sāra.asāraṃ ca bhāṇḍānāṃ deśānāṃ ca guṇa.aguṇān |
bhṛtyānāṃ ca bhṛtiṃ vidyād bhāṣāś ca vividhā nṛṇāṃ |

dravyāṇāṃ sthāna.yogāṃś ca kraya.vikrayam eva ca || 332
                                ||
dharmeṇa ca dravyavṛddhāv ātiṣṭhed yatnam uttamam |
dadyāc ca sarvabhūtānām annam eva prayatnataḥ || 333 ||
śuśrūṣā-eva tu śūdrasya dharmo naiśreyasaḥ paraḥ || 334 ||
9.3. Conclusion of the Law Outside Times of Adversity
āpady api hi yas teṣāṃ kramaśas tan nibodhata || 336 ||

prabrūyād brāhmaṇas tv eṣāṃ na-itarāv iti niścayaḥ || 1
                                    ||

prabrūyād itarebhyaś ca svayaṃ ca-eva tathā bhavet || 2
                                    ||

saṃskārasya viśeṣāc ca varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 3
                                    ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyas trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ |

caturtha ekajātis tu śūdro na-asti tu pañcamaḥ || 4
                                    ||
ānulomyena sambhūtā jātyā jñeyās ta eva te || 5 ||

dvi.ekāntarāsu jātānāṃ dharmyaṃ vidyād imaṃ vidhim || 7
                                    ||
viprasya triṣu varṇeṣu nṛpater varṇayor dvayoḥ |

vaiśyasya varṇe ca-ekasmin ṣaḍ ete 'pasadāḥ smṛtāḥ || 10
                                    ||
śūdrād āyogavaḥ kṣattā caṇḍālaś ca-adhamo nṛṇām |
ekāntare tv ānulomyād ambaṣṭha.ugrau yathā smṛtau |
āyogavaś ca kṣattā ca caṇḍālaś ca-adhamo nṛṇām |
vaiśyān māgadha.vaidehau kṣatriyāt sūta eva tu |

pratīpam ete jāyante pare 'py apasadās trayaḥ || 17
                                    ||

śūdrāj jāto niṣādyāṃ tu sa vai kukkuṭakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 18
                                    ||
kṣattur jātas tathā-ugrāyāṃ śvapāka iti kīrtyate |

vaidehakena tv ambaṣṭhyām utpanno veṇa ucyate || 19
                                    ||
dvijātayaḥ savarṇāsu janayanty a.vratāṃs tu yān |
vrātyāt tu jāyate viprāt pāpa.ātmā bhūrjakaṇṭakaḥ|

āvantya.vāṭadhānau ca puṣpadhaḥ śaikha eva ca || 21
                                    ||
jhallo mallaś ca rājanyād vrātyāt-nicchivir eva ca |

naṭaś ca karaṇaś ca-eva khaso draviḍa eva ca || 22
                                    ||
vaiśyāt tu jāyate vrātyāt sudhanvā-ācārya eva ca |

                                    ||

māgadhaḥ tathā-āyogava eva ca kṣatrajātiś ca || 26 ||
ete ṣaṭ sadṛśān varṇāñ janayanti svayoniṣu |

                                    ||

hīnā hīnān prasūyante varṇān pañcadaśa-eva tu || 31
                                    ||

bhavanty āyogavīṣv ete jātihīnāḥ pṛthak trayaḥ || 35
                                    ||

prachannā vā prakāśā vā veditavyāḥ svakarmabhiḥ || 40
                                    ||
tapo.bīja.prabhāvais tu te gacchanti yuge yuge |

utkarṣaṃ ca-apakarṣaṃ ca manuṣyeṣv iha janmataḥ || 42

mleccha.vācaś ca-ārya.vācaḥ sarve te dasyavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
                                    45 ||

te ninditair vartayeyur dvijānām eva karmabhiḥ || 46
                                    ||
matsyaghāto niṣādānāṃ tvaṣṭis tv āyogavasya ca |

apapātrāś ca kartavyā dhanam eṣāṃ śva.gardabham || 51
                                    ||
na taiḥ samayam anvicchet puruṣo dharmam ācaran |

vyavahāro mithas teṣāṃ vivāhaḥ sadṛśaiḥ saha || 53
                                    ||
annam eṣāṃ parādhīnaṃ deyaṃ syād bhinnabhājane |
rātrau na vicareyus te grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca || 54 ||

a.bāndhavaṃ śavaṃ ca-eva nirhareyur iti sthitiḥ || 55
                                    ||
vadhyāṃś ca hanyuḥ satataṃ yathāśāstraṃ nṛpājñayā |
pitryaṃ vā bhajate śīlaṃ mātur vā-ubhayam eva vā |

na kathaṃ cana duryoniḥ prakṛtiṃ svāṃ niyacchati || 59
                                    ||
kule mukhye 'pi jātasya yasya syād yonisaṅkaraḥ |

saṃśrayaty eva tat.śīlaṃ naro 'lpam api vā bahu || 60
                                    ||
yatra tv ete paridhvaṃsāj jāyante varṇadūṣakāḥ |

                                    ||
śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇāj jātaḥ śreyasā cet prajāyate |

aśreyān śreyasīṃ jātiṃ gacchaty ā saptamād yugāt || 64
                                    ||
śūdro brāhmaṇatām eti brāhmaṇaś ca-eti śūdratām |

kṣatriyāj jātam evaṃ tu vidyād vaiśyāt tathā-eva ca ||
                                    65 ||

brāhmaṇyām apy anāryāt tu śreyastvaṃ kva-iti ced bhavet
                                    || 66 ||
jāto nāryām anāryāyām āryād āryo bhaved guṇaiḥ |

jāto 'py anāryād āryāyām anārya iti niścayaḥ || 67
                                    ||
tāv ubhāv apy asaṃskāryāv iti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ |
subījaṃ ca-eva sukṣetre jātaṃ sampadyate yathā |

tathā-āryāj jāta āryāyāṃ sarvaṃ saṃskāram arhati || 69
                                    ||
bījam eke praśaṃsanti kṣetram anye manīṣiṇaḥ |

a.bījakam api kṣetraṃ kevalaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ bhavet || 71
                                    ||
pūjitāś ca praśastāś ca tasmād bījaṃ praśasyate || 72 ||

sampradhārya-abravīd dhātā na samau na-asamāv iti || 73
                                    ||
te samyag upajīveyuḥ ṣaṭ karmāṇi yathākramam || 74 ||

dānaṃ pratigrahaś ca-eva ṣaṭ karmāṇy agrajanmanaḥ || 75
                                ||
ṣaṇṇāṃ tu karmaṇām asya trīṇi karmāṇi jīvikā |
trayo dharmā nivartante brāhmaṇāt kṣatriyaṃ prati |
adhyāpanaṃ yājanaṃ ca tṛtīyaś ca pratigrahaḥ || 77 ||
vaiśyaṃ prati tathā-eva-ete nivarterann iti sthitiḥ |
na tau prati hi tān dharmān manur āha prajāpatiḥ || 78 ||
ājīvanārthaṃ dharmas tu dānam adhyayanaṃ yajiḥ || 79 ||
a.jīvaṃs tu yathā.uktena brāhmaṇaḥ svena karmaṇā |

jīvet kṣatriyadharmeṇa sa hy asya praty anantaraḥ || 81
                                    ||

ubhābhyām apy a.jīvaṃs tu kathaṃ syād iti ced bhavet
                                    |

vaiśyavṛttyā-api jīvaṃs tu brāhmaṇaḥ ksatriyo 'pi vā
                                    |
kṛṣiṃ sādhu-iti manyante sā vṛttiḥ sadvigarhitāḥ |

bhūmiṃ bhūmiśayāṃś ca-eva hanti kāṣṭham ayo.mukham || 84
                                    ||
sarvān rasān apoheta kṛtānnaṃ ca tilaiḥ saha |
aśmano lavaṇaṃ ca-eva paśavo ye ca mānuṣāḥ || 86 ||

api cet syur araktāni phala.mūle tathā-oṣadhīḥ || 87
                                    ||

apaḥ śastraṃ viṣaṃ māṃsaṃ somaṃ gandhāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
                                    |

kṣīraṃ kṣaudraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ madhu guḍaṃ kuśān ||
                                    88 ||
āraṇyāṃś ca paśūn sarvān daṃṣṭriṇaś ca vayāṃsi ca |

madyaṃ nīliṃ ca lākṣāṃ ca sarvāṃś ca-eka.śaphāṃs tathā
                                    || 89 ||
kāmam utpādya kṛṣyāṃ tu svayam eva kṛṣīvalaḥ |
bhojana.abhyañjanād dānād yad anyat kurute tilaiḥ |
sadyaḥ patati māṃsena lākṣayā lavaṇena ca |
itareṣāṃ tu paṇyānāṃ vikrayād iha kāmataḥ |
rasā rasair nimātavyā na tv eva lavaṇaṃ rasaiḥ |

kṛtānnaṃ ca kṛtānnena tilā dhānyena tatsamāḥ || 94
                                    ||
jīved etena rājanyaḥ sarveṇa-apy anayaṃ gataḥ |

na tv eva jyāyaṃsīṃ vṛttim abhimanyeta karhi cit || 95
                                    ||
yo lobhād adhamo jātyā jīved utkṛṣṭa.karmabhiḥ |

taṃ rājā nirdhanaṃ kṛtvā kṣipram eva pravāsayet || 96
                                    ||
varaṃ svadharmo viguṇo na pārakyaḥ svanuṣṭhitaḥ |
paradharmeṇa jīvan hi sadyaḥ patati jātitaḥ || 97 ||
a.śaknuvaṃs tu śuśrūṣāṃ śūdraḥ kartuṃ dvijanmanām |

vaiśyavṛttim an.ātiṣṭhan brāhmaṇaḥ sve pathi sthitaḥ
                                    |
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyād brāhmaṇas tv anayaṃ gataḥ |
na-adhyāpanād yājanād vā garhitād vā pratigrahāt |

doṣo bhavati viprāṇāṃ jvalana.ambu.samā hi te || 103
                                    ||
jīvitātyayam āpanno yo 'nnam atti tatas tataḥ |
ākāśam iva paṅkena na sa pāpena lipyate || 104 ||
bharadvājaḥ kṣudhārtas tu sa.putro vijane vane |

bahvīr gāḥ pratijagrāha vṛdhos takṣṇo mahātapāḥ || 107
                                    ||

pratigrahas tu kriyate śūdrād apy antya.janmanaḥ || 110
                                    ||
śila.uñcham apy ādadīta vipro '.jīvan yatas tataḥ |
sīdadbhiḥ kupyam icchadbhir dhane vā pṛthivīpatiḥ |

yācyaḥ syāt snātakair viprair aditsaṃs tyāgam arhati ||
                                    113 ||
akṛtaṃ ca kṛtāt kṣetrād gaur ajāvikam eva ca |

hiraṇyaṃ dhānyam annaṃ ca pūrvaṃ pūrvam adoṣavat || 114
                                    ||
sapta vittāgamā dharmyā dāyo lābhaḥ krayo jayaḥ |

prayogaḥ karmayogaś ca satpratigraha eva ca || 115
                                    ||
vidyā śilpaṃ bhṛtiḥ sevā gorakṣyaṃ vipaṇiḥ kṛṣiḥ |

dhṛtir bhaikṣaṃ kusīdaṃ ca daśa jīvanahetavaḥ || 116
                                    ||

brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vā-api vṛddhiṃ na-eva prayojayet
                                    |

kāmaṃ tu khalu dharmārthaṃ dadyāt pāpīyase 'lpikām ||
                                    117 ||

prajā rakṣan paraṃ śaktyā kilbiṣāt pratimucyate || 118
                                    ||

svadharmo vijayas tasya na-āhave syāt parāṅ.mukhaḥ
                                    |

śastreṇa vaiśyān rakṣitvā dharmyam āhārayed balim ||
                                    119 ||
śūdras tu vṛttim ākāṅkṣan kṣatram ārādhayed yadi |

dhaninaṃ vā-apy upārādhya vaiśyaṃ śūdro jijīviṣet ||
                                    121 ||

svargārtham ubhayārthaṃ vā viprān ārādhayet tu saḥ
                                    |

yad ato 'nyadd hi kurute tad bhavaty asya niṣphalam ||
                                    123 ||

prakalpyā tasya tair vṛttiḥ svakuṭumbād yathārhataḥ
                                    |

śaktiṃ ca-avekṣya dākṣyaṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ ca parigraham ||
                                    124 ||
ucchiṣṭam annaṃ dātavyaṃ jīrṇāni vasanāni ca |

pulākāś ca-eva dhānyānāṃ jīrṇāś ca-eva paricchadāḥ ||
                                    125 ||
na śūdre pātakaṃ kiṃ cin na ca saṃskāram arhati |
dharma.ipsavas tu dharmajñāḥ satāṃ vṛttam anuṣṭhitāḥ |

mantravarjyaṃ na duṣyanti praśaṃsāṃ prāpnuvanti ca ||
                                    127 ||
yathā yathā hi sadvṛttam ātiṣṭhaty anasūyakaḥ |

tathā tathā-imaṃ ca-amuṃ ca lokaṃ prāpnoty aninditaḥ ||
                                    128 ||
śaktena-api hi śūdreṇa na kāryo dhanasañcayaḥ |

śūdro hi dhanam āsādya brāhmaṇān eva bādhate || 129
                                    ||

yān samyag anutiṣṭhanto vrajanti paramaṃ gatim || 130
                                ||

viśvaiś ca devaiḥ sādhyaiś ca brāhmaṇaiś ca

na tv alpa.dakṣiṇair yajñair yajeta-iha kathaṃ

indriyāṇi yaśaḥ svargam āyuḥ kīrtiṃ prajāḥ paśūn

ātmano yadi vā-anyeṣāṃ gṛhe kṣetre 'tha vā khale
                                    |

bhakṣayantīṃ na kathayet pibantaṃ ca-eva
                                    vatsakam || 114 ||

anena vidhinā yas tu goghno gām anugacchati
                                    |

sa gohatyākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tribhir māsair vyapohati
                                    || 115 ||
etad eva vrataṃ kuryur upapātakino dvijāḥ |
11.1.6.3. Student Breaking the Vow of Chastity

hutvā-agnau vidhivadd homān antataś ca sama-ity
                                    ṛcā |
mārutaṃ puruhūtaṃ ca guruṃ pāvakam eva ca |

upaspṛśaṃs triṣavaṇaṃ tv abdena sa viśudhyati ||
                                    123 ||
11.1.7. Penances for the Remaining Categories of Sins

vaiśye 'ṣṭamāṃśo vṛttasthe śūdre jñeyas tu ṣoḍaśaḥ
                                || 126 ||
11.1.8. Excursus: Penances for Injury to Living Beings

tryabdaṃ cared vā niyato jaṭī brahmahaṇo vratam
                                    |

etad eva cared abdaṃ prāyaścittaṃ dvijottamaḥ
                                    |

etad eva vrataṃ kṛtsnaṃ ṣaṇmāsān-śūdrahā caret
                                    |

vṛṣabha.ekādaśā vā-api dadyād viprāya gāḥ sitāḥ
                                    || 130 ||

mārjāra.nakulau hatvā cāṣaṃ maṇḍūkam eva ca
                                    |

payaḥ pibet trirātraṃ vā yojanaṃ vā-adhvano
                                    vrajet |

upaspṛśet sravantyāṃ vā sūktaṃ vā-ab.daivataṃ
                                    japet || 132 ||

abhriṃ kārṣṇāyasīṃ dadyāt sarpaṃ hatvā
                                    dvijottamaḥ |

ghṛtakumbhaṃ varāhe tu tiladroṇaṃ tu tittirau
                                    |

śuke dvihāyanaṃ vatsaṃ krauñcaṃ hatvā trihāyanam
                                    || 134 ||

hatvā haṃsaṃ balākāṃ ca bakaṃ barhiṇam eva ca
                                    |

vānaraṃ śyena.bhāsau ca sparśayed brāhmaṇāya gām
                                    || 135 ||

vāso dadyādd hayaṃ hatvā pañca nīlān vṛṣān gajam
                                    |

kravyādāṃs tu mṛgān hatvā dhenuṃ dadyāt
                                    payasvinīm |

akravyādān vatsatarīm uṣṭraṃ hatvā tu kṛṣṇalam
                                    || 137 ||

pūrṇe ca-anasy an.asthnāṃ tu śūdrahatyāvrataṃ
                                    caret || 140 ||

kiṃ cid eva tu viprāya dadyād asthimatāṃ vadhe
                                    |

phaladānāṃ tu vṛkṣāṇāṃ chedane japyam ṛc.śatam
                                    |

kṛṣtajānām oṣadhīnāṃ jātānāṃ ca svayaṃ vane
                                    |

etair vratair apohyaṃ syād eno hiṃsā.samudbhavam
                                    |
11.1.9. Excursus: Penances for Eating Forbidden Food

spṛṣṭva dattvā ca madirāṃ vidhivat pratigṛhya ca
                                |

śūdra.ucchiṣṭāś ca pītvā-apaḥ kuśavāri pibet tryaham
                                || 148 ||
brāhmaṇas tu surāpasya gandham āghrāya somapaḥ |

prāṇān apsu trir āyamya ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati ||
                                149 ||

ajñānāt prāśya viṣ.mūtraṃ surāsaṃspṛṣṭam eva ca
                                |

punaḥ saṃskāram arhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ ||
                                150 ||
vapanaṃ mekhalā daṇḍo bhaikṣacaryā vratāni ca |

abhojyānāṃ tu bhuktvā-annaṃ strī.śūdra.ucchiṣṭam eva
                                ca |

jagdhvā māṃsam abhakṣyaṃ ca saptarātraṃ yavān pibet
                                || 152 ||

śuktāni ca kaṣāyāṃś ca pītvā medhyāny api dvijaḥ
                                |

tāvad bhavaty a.prayato yāvat tan na vrajaty adhaḥ
                                || 153 ||
śuṣkāṇi bhuktvā māṃsāni bhaumāni kavakāni ca |

ajñātaṃ ca-eva sūnāstham etad eva vrataṃ caret ||
                                155 ||

sa trīṇy ahāny upavased ekāhaṃ ca-udake vaset || 157
                                ||
brahmacārī tu yo 'śnīyān madhu māṃsaṃ kathaṃ cana |

sa kṛtvā prākṛtaṃ kṛcchraṃ vrataśeṣaṃ samāpayet ||
                                158 ||

abhojyam annaṃ na-attavyam ātmanaḥ śuddhim icchatā
                                |

ajñānabhuktaṃ tu-uttāryaṃ śodhyaṃ vā-apy āśu
                                śodhanaiḥ || 160 ||
manuṣyāṇāṃ tu haraṇe strīṇāṃ kṣetra.gṛhasya ca |

caret sāntapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ tan niryāty ātmaśuddhaye
                                || 164 ||

pakṣi.gandha.oṣadhīnāṃ ca rajjvāś ca-eva tryahaṃ
                                payaḥ || 168 ||
etair vratair apoheta pāpaṃ steyakṛtaṃ dvijaḥ |

sakhyuḥ putrasya ca strīṣu kumārīṣv antyajāsu ca ||
                                170 ||
paitṛsvaseyīṃ bhaginīṃ svasrīyāṃ mātur eva ca |

mātuś ca bhrātus tanayāṃ gatvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret ||
                                171 ||

etās tisras tu bhāryārthe na-upayacchet tu buddhimān
                                |

jñātitvena-an.upeyās tāḥ patati hy upayann adhaḥ ||
                                172 ||

retaḥ siktvā jale ca-eva kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret
                                || 173 ||
maithunaṃ tu samāsevya puṃsi yoṣiti vā dvijaḥ |

go.yāne 'psu divā ca-eva sa.vāsāḥ snānam ācaret ||
                                174 ||

caṇḍāla.antyastriyo gatvā bhuktvā ca pratigṛhya ca
                                |

pataty ajñānato vipro jñānāt sāmyaṃ tu gacchati ||
                                175 ||

yat puṃsaḥ paradāreṣu tac ca-enāṃ cārayed vratam ||
                                176 ||
sā cet punaḥ praduṣyet tu sadṛśena-upamantritā |

kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ ca-eva tad asyāḥ pāvanaṃ smṛtam
                                || 177 ||

tad bhaikṣabhuj-japan nityaṃ tribhir varṣair
                                vyapohati || 178 ||
eṣā pāpakṛtām uktā caturṇām api niṣkṛtiḥ |
yo yena patitena-eṣāṃ saṃsargaṃ yāti mānavaḥ |

dāsī ghaṭam apāṃ pūrṇaṃ paryasyet pretavat padā
                                    |

dāyādyasya pradānaṃ ca yātrā ca-eva hi laukikī
                                    || 184 ||

jyeṣṭhatā ca nivarteta jyeṣṭhāvāpyaṃ ca yad
                                    dhanam |

prāyaścitte tu carite pūrṇakumbham apāṃ navam
                                    |

tena-eva sārdhaṃ prāsyeyuḥ snātvā puṇye jalāśaye
                                    || 186 ||

sa tv apsu taṃ ghaṭaṃ prāsya praviśya bhavanaṃ
                                    svakam |
etad eva vidhiṃ kuryād yoṣitsu patitāsv api |

vastra.anna.pānaṃ deyaṃ tu vaseyuś ca gṛhāntike
                                    || 188 ||

enasvibhir a.nirṇiktair na-arthaṃ kiṃ cit
                                    saha-ācaret |

kṛtanirṇejanāṃś ca-eva na jugupseta karhi cit ||
                                    189 ||

bālaghnāṃś ca kṛtaghnāṃś ca viśuddhān api
                                    dharmataḥ |

śaraṇāgatahantṝṃś ca strīhantṝṃś ca na saṃvaset
                                    || 190 ||
11.1.13. Excursus: Miscellanea on Sin and Penance

prāyaścittaṃ cikīrṣanti vikarmasthās tu ye dvijāḥ
                                |

brahmaṇā ca parityaktās teṣām apy etad ādiśet || 192
                                ||
upavāsakṛśaṃ taṃ tu govrajāt punar āgatam |

praṇataṃ prati pṛccheyuḥ sāmyaṃ saumya-icchasi-iti
                                kim || 195 ||
satyam uktvā tu vipreṣu vikired yavasaṃ gavām |

gobhiḥ pravartite tīrthe kuryus tasya parigraham ||
                                196 ||
vrātyānāṃ yājanaṃ kṛtvā pareṣām antyakarma ca |

abhicāram ahīnaṃ ca tribhiḥ kṛcchrair vyapohati ||
                                197 ||

śaraṇāgataṃ parityajya vedaṃ viplāvya ca dvijaḥ
                                |

śva.śṛgāla.kharair daṣṭo grāmyaiḥ kravyādbhir eva ca
                                |

homāś ca sakalā nityam apāṅktyānāṃ viśodhanam || 200
                                ||

snātvā tu vipro dig.vāsāḥ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati ||
                                201 ||

vinā-adbhir apsu vā-apy ārtaḥ śārīraṃ sanniṣevya ca
                                |

sa.cailo bahir āplutya gām ālabhya viśudhyati || 202
                                ||
avagūrya tv abdaśataṃ sahasram abhihatya ca |

śaktiṃ ca-avekṣya pāpaṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ prakalpayet
                                || 209 ||

tryahaṃ prātas tryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryaham adyād ayācitam
                                |

tryahaṃ paraṃ ca na-aśnīyāt prājāpatyaṃ caran dvijaḥ
                                || 211 ||

gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśa.udakam
                                    |

ekaikaṃ grāsam aśnīyāt tryahāṇi trīṇi pūrvavat
                                    |

tryahaṃ ca-upavased antyam atikṛcchraṃ caran
                                    dvijaḥ || 213 ||

ekaikaṃ hrāsayet piṇḍaṃ kṛṣṇe śukle ca vardhayet
                                    |

etam eva vidhiṃ kṛtsnam ācared yavamadhyame
                                    |

aṣṭāv aṣṭau samaśnīyāt piṇḍān madhyandine sthite
                                    |

caturaḥ prātar aśnīyāt piṇḍān vipraḥ samāhitaḥ
                                    |

yathā kathaṃ cit piṇḍānāṃ tisro 'śītīḥ samāhitaḥ
                                    |

etad rudrās tathā-ādityā vasavaś ca-ācaran
                                    vratam |

ahiṃsā satyam akrodham ārjavaṃ ca samācaret ||
                                    222 ||

trir ahnas trir niśāyāṃ ca sa.vāsā jalam āviśet
                                    |

sāvitrīṃ ca japen nityaṃ pavitrāṇi ca śaktitaḥ
                                    |

sarveṣv eva vrateṣv evaṃ prāyaścittārtham ādṛtaḥ
                                    || 225 ||

anāviṣkṛta.pāpāṃs tu mantrair homaiś ca śodhayet
                                    || 226 ||

yathā yathā manas tasya duṣkṛtaṃ karma garhati
                                    |

tathā tathā śarīraṃ tat tena-adharmeṇa mucyate
                                    || 229 ||

kṛtvā pāpaṃ hi santapya tasmāt pāpāt pramucyate
                                    |

na-evaṃ kuryāṃ punar iti nivṛttyā pūyate tu saḥ
                                    || 230 ||

ajñānād yadi vā jñānāt kṛtvā karma vigarhitam
                                    |

tasmād vimuktim anvicchan dvitīyaṃ na samācaret
                                    || 232 ||

yasmin karmaṇy asya kṛte manasaḥ syād alāghavam
                                    |

tasmiṃs tāvat tapaḥ kuryād yāvat tuṣṭikaraṃ
                                    bhavet || 233 ||

brāhmaṇasya tapo jñānaṃ tapaḥ kṣatrasya rakṣaṇam
                                    |

vaiśyasya tu tapo vārtā tapaḥ śūdrasya sevanam
                                    || 235 ||

auṣadhāny agado vidyā daivī ca vividhā sthitiḥ
                                    |

tapasā-eva prasidhyanti tapas teṣāṃ hi sādhanam
                                    || 237 ||

yad dustaraṃ yad durāpaṃ yad durgaṃ yac ca
                                    duṣkaram |

sarvaṃ tu tapasā sādhyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam ||
                                    238 ||

kītāś ca-ahi.pataṅgāś ca paśavaś ca vayāṃsi ca
                                    |

sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni divaṃ yānti tapobalāt ||
                                    240 ||

yat kiṃ cid enaḥ kurvanti mano.vāc.mūrtibhir
                                    janāḥ |

tat sarvaṃ nirdahanty āśu tapasā-eva tapo.dhanāḥ
                                    || 241 ||

ijyāś ca pratigṛhṇanti kāmān saṃvardhayanti ca
                                    || 242 ||
ity etat tapaso devā mahābhāgyaṃ pracakṣate |

yathā-edhas tejasā vahniḥ prāptaṃ nirdahati
                                    kṣaṇāt |

tathā jñānāgninā pāpaṃ sarvaṃ dahati vedavit ||
                                    246 ||

ity etad enasām uktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathāvidhi
                                    |

api bhrūṇahanaṃ māsāt punanty ahar ahaḥ kṛtāḥ ||
                                    248 ||

kautsaṃ japtvā-apa ity etad vasiṣṭhaṃ ca
                                    prati-ity ṛcam |

apahṛtya suvarṇaṃ tu kṣaṇād bhavati nir.malaḥ ||
                                    250 ||

haviṣpāntīyam abhyasya na tamaṃ ha iti-iti ca
                                    |

ava-ity ṛcaṃ japed abdaṃ yat kiṃ ca-idam iti-iti
                                    vā || 252 ||

somāraudram tu bahv.enāḥ māsam abhyasya śudhyati
                                    |

sravantyām ācaran snānam aryamṇām iti ca tṛcam
                                    || 254 ||

abdārdham indram ity etad enasvī saptakaṃ japet
                                    |

apraśastaṃ tu kṛtvā-apsu māsam āsīta bhaikṣabhuk
                                    || 255 ||

mantraiḥ śākalahomīyair abdaṃ hutvā ghṛtaṃ
                                    dvijaḥ |

sugurv apy apahanty eno japtvā vā nama ity ṛcam
                                    || 256 ||

araṇye vā trir abhyasya prayato vedasaṃhitām
                                    |

mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ parākaiḥ śodhitas
                                    tribhiḥ || 258 ||

tryahaṃ tu-upavased yuktas trir ahno 'bhyupayann
                                    apaḥ |

hatvā lokān api-imāṃs trīn aśnann api yatas
                                    tataḥ |

ṛgvedaṃ dhārayan vipro na-enaḥ prāpnoti kiṃ cana
                                    || 261 ||

ṛksaṃhitāṃ trir abhyasya yajuṣāṃ vā samāhitaḥ
                                    |

yathā mahāhradaṃ prāpya kṣiptaṃ loṣṭaṃ vinaśyati
                                    |

tathā duścaritaṃ sarvaṃ vede trivṛti majjati ||
                                    263 ||
ṛco yajūṃṣi ca-anyāni sāmāni vividhāni ca |

eṣa jñeyas trivṛdvedo yo veda-enaṃ sa vedavit ||
                                    264 ||

ādyaṃ yat tryakṣaraṃ brahma trayī yasmin
                                    pratiṣṭhitā |

sa guhyo 'nyas trivṛdvedo yas taṃ veda sa
                                    vedavit || 265 ||
karmaṇāṃ phalanirvṛttiṃ śaṃsa nas tattvataḥ parām || 1 ||
sa tān uvāca dharma.ātmā maharṣīn mānavo bhṛguḥ |
pāruṣyam anṛtaṃ ca-eva paiśunyaṃ ca-api sarvaśaḥ |
vācā vācā kṛtaṃ karma kāyena-eva ca kāyikam || 8 ||
yasya-ete nihitā buddhau tridaṇḍī-iti sa ucyate || 10 ||
kāma.krodhau tu saṃyamya tataḥ siddhiṃ niyacchati || 11 ||

yaḥ karoti tu karmāṇi sa bhūtātmā-ucyate budhaiḥ || 12
                                    ||

yena vedayate sarvaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca janmasu || 13
                                    ||
tāv ubhau bhūtasampṛktau mahān kṣetrajña eva ca |

uccāvaceṣu bhūteṣu sthitaṃ taṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhataḥ || 14
                                    ||
pañcabhya eva mātrābhyaḥ pretya duṣkṛtināṃ nṛṇām |

tau dharmaṃ paśyatas tasya pāpaṃ ca-atandritau saha
                                    |

yābhyāṃ prāpnoti sampṛktaḥ pretya-iha ca sukha.asukham
                                    || 19 ||
yady ācarati dharmaṃ sa prāyaśo 'dharmam alpaśaḥ |

tair eva ca-āvṛto bhūtaiḥ svarge sukham upāśnute || 20
                                    ||
yadi tu prāyaśo 'dharmaṃ sevate dharmam alpaśaḥ |

tair bhūtaiḥ sa parityakto yāmīḥ prāpnoti yātanāḥ || 21
                                    ||
yāmīs tā yātanāḥ prāpya sa jīvo vīta.kalmaṣaḥ |

tāny eva pañca bhūtāni punar apyeti bhāgaśaḥ || 22
                                    ||
etā dṛṣṭvā-asya jīvasya gatīḥ svena-eva cetasā |

dharmato 'dharmataś ca-eva dharme dadhyāt sadā manaḥ ||
                                    23 ||

sattvaṃ rajas tamas-ca-eva trīn vidyād ātmano guṇān
                                    |

yair vyāpya-imān sthito bhāvān mahān sarvān aśeṣataḥ ||
                                    24 ||
sa tadā tadguṇaprāyaṃ taṃ karoti śarīriṇam || 25 ||

sattvaṃ jñānaṃ tamo 'jñānaṃ rāga.dveṣau rajaḥ smṛtam
                                    |
tatra yat prītisaṃyuktaṃ kiṃ cid ātmani lakṣayet |

praśāntam iva śuddhābhaṃ sattvaṃ tad upadhārayet || 27
                                    ||
tad rajo pratīpaṃ vidyāt satataṃ hāri dehinām || 28 ||
yat tu syān mohasaṃyuktam avyaktaṃ viṣayātmakam |
trayāṇām api ca-eteṣāṃ guṇānāṃ yaḥ phala.udayaḥ |

agryo madhyo jaghanyaś ca taṃ pravakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ || 30
                                    ||
trayāṇām api ca-eteṣāṃ guṇānāṃ triṣu tiṣṭhatām |

yat karma kṛtvā kurvaṃś ca kariṣyaṃś ca-eva lajjati
                                    |

taj jñeyaṃ viduṣā sarvaṃ tāmasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam || 35
                                    ||
yena-asmin karmanā loke khyātim icchati puṣkalām |

na ca śocaty asampattau tad vijñeyaṃ tu rājasam || 36
                                    ||

yat sarveṇa-icchati jñātuṃ yan na lajjati ca-ācaran
                                    |
tamaso lakṣaṇaṃ kāmo rajasas tv artha ucyate |

sattvasya lakṣaṇaṃ dharmaḥ śraiṣṭhyam eṣāṃ yathā.uttaram
                                    || 38 ||
yena yas tu guṇena-eṣāṃ saṃsarān pratipadyate |
devatvaṃ sāttvikā yānti manuṣyatvaṃ ca rājasāḥ |

tiryaktvaṃ tāmasā nityam ity eṣā trividhā gatiḥ || 40
                                    ||
trividhā trividhā-eṣā tu vijñeyā gauṇikī gatiḥ |

sthāvarāḥ kṛmi.kīṭāś ca matsyāḥ sarpāḥ sa.kacchapāḥ
                                    |

paśavaś ca mṛgāś ca-eva jaghanyā tāmasī gatiḥ || 42
                                    ||
hastinaś ca turaṅgāś ca śūdrā mlecchāś ca garhitāḥ |

siṃhā vyāghrā varāhāś ca madhyamā tāmasī gatiḥ || 43
                                    ||
cāraṇāś ca suparṇāś ca puruṣāś ca-eva dāmbhikāḥ |

rakṣāṃsi ca piśācāś ca tāmasīṣu-uttamā gatiḥ || 44
                                    ||
jhallā mallā naṭāś ca-eva puruṣāḥ śastra.vṛttayaḥ |
rājānaḥ kṣatriyāś ca-eva rājñāṃ ca-eva purohitāḥ |
gandharvā guhyakā yakṣā vibudhānucarāś ca ye |
tāpasā yatayo viprā ye ca vaimānikā gaṇāḥ |

nakṣatrāṇi ca daityāś ca prathamā sāttvikī gatiḥ || 48
                                    ||
yajvāna ṛṣayo devā vedā jyotīṃṣi vatsarāḥ |

pitaraś ca-eva sādhyāś ca dvitīyā sāttvikī gatiḥ || 49
                                    ||
brahmā viśvasṛjo dharmo mahān avyaktam eva ca |
uttamāṃ sāttvikīm etāṃ gatim āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 50 ||
yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ tu jīvo 'yaṃ yena yena-iha karmaṇā |

kramaśo yāti loke 'smiṃs tat tat sarvaṃ nibodhata || 53
                                    ||
bahūn varṣagaṇān ghorān narakān prāpya tatkṣayāt |

hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca-eva sattvānāṃ surāpo brāhmaṇo vrajet || 56
                                    ||

hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca piśācānāṃ steno vipraḥ sahasraśaḥ || 57
                                    ||
saṃyogaṃ patitair gatvā parasya-eva ca yoṣitam |

dhānyaṃ hṛtvā bhavaty ākhuḥ kāṃsyaṃ haṃso jalaṃ plavaḥ
                                    |

madhu daṃśaḥ payaḥ kāko rasaṃ śvā nakulo ghṛtam || 62
                                    ||

māṃsaṃ gṛdhro vapāṃ madgus tailaṃ tailapakaḥ khagaḥ
                                    |
cīrīvākas tu lavaṇaṃ balākā śakunir dadhi || 63 ||
kauśeyaṃ tittirir hṛtvā kṣaumaṃ hṛtvā tu darduraḥ |

kārpāsatāntavaṃ krauñco godhā gāṃ vāggudo guḍam || 64
                                    ||
chucchundariḥ śubhān gandhān patraśākaṃ tu barhiṇaḥ |

śvāvit kṛtānnaṃ vividham akṛtānnaṃ tu śalyakaḥ || 65
                                    ||
bako bhavati hṛtvā-agniṃ gṛhakārī hy upaskaram |

vṛko mṛga.ibhaṃ vyāghro 'śvaṃ phala.mūlaṃ tu markaṭaḥ
                                    |

strīm ṛkṣaḥ stokako vāri yānāny uṣṭraḥ paśūn ajaḥ || 67
                                    ||
yad vā tad vā paradravyam apahṛtya balāt-naraḥ |

avaśyaṃ yāti tiryaktvaṃ jagdhvā ca-eva-ahutaṃ haviḥ ||
                                    68 ||
striyo 'py etena kalpena hṛtvā doṣam avāpnuyuḥ |
eteṣām eva jantūnāṃ bhāryātvam upayānti tāḥ || 69 ||

svebhyaḥ svebhyas tu karmabhyaś cyutā varṇā hy anāpadi
                                    |
pāpān saṃsṛtya saṃsārān preṣyatāṃ yānti śatruṣu || 70 ||

vāntāśy ulkāmukhaḥ preto vipro dharmāt svakāc cyutaḥ
                                    |

cailāśakaś ca bhavati śūdro dharmāt svakāc cyutaḥ || 72
                                    ||

samprāpnuvanti duḥkhāni tāsu tāsv iha yoniṣu || 74
                                    ||
vividhāś ca-eva sampīḍāḥ kāka.ulūkaiś ca bhakṣaṇam |
asakṛd garbhavāseṣu vāsaṃ janma ca dāruṇam |
bandhanāni ca kāṣṭhāni parapreṣyatvam eva ca || 78 ||

dravyārjanaṃ ca nāśaṃ ca mitra.amitrasya ca-arjanam ||
                                    79 ||

kleśāṃś ca vividhāṃs tāṃs tān mṛtyum eva ca dur.jayam ||
                                    80 ||
yādṛśena tu bhāvena yad yat karma niṣevate |
tādṛśena śarīreṇa tat tat phalam upāśnute || 81 ||
eṣa sarvaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ karmaṇāṃ vaḥ phala.udayaḥ |
12.1.2. Actions Leading to the Supreme Good
vedābhyāsas tapo jñānam indriyāṇāṃ ca saṃyamaḥ |
sarveṣām api ca-eteṣāṃ śubhānām iha karmaṇām |
sarveṣām api ca-eteṣām ātmajñānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam |

tadd hy agryaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ prāpyate hy amṛtaṃ tataḥ || 85
                                ||
ṣaṇṇām eṣāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ pretya ca-iha ca |
vaidike karmayoge tu sarvāṇy etāny aśeṣataḥ |

pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ karma vaidikam || 88
                                ||
iha ca-amutra vā kāmyaṃ pravṛttaṃ karma kīrtyate |
pravṛttaṃ karma saṃsevyaṃ devānām eti sāmyatām |
nivṛttaṃ sevamānas tu bhūtāny atyeti pañca vai || 90 ||
ātmajñāne śame ca syād vedābhyāse ca yatnavān || 92 ||

prāpya-etat kṛta.kṛtyo hi dvijo bhavati na-anyathā || 93
                                ||
aśakyaṃ ca-aprameyaṃ ca vedaśāstram iti sthitiḥ || 94 ||
yā vedabāhyāḥ smṛtayo yāś ca kāś ca kudṛṣṭayaḥ |

sarvās tā niṣ.phalāḥ pretya tamo.niṣṭhā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ || 95
                                ||
utpadyante cyavante ca yāny ato 'nyāni kāni cit |
cāturvarṇyaṃ trayo lokāś catvāraś ca-āśramāḥ pṛthak |

bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca sarvaṃ vedāt prasidhyati || 97
                                ||
śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaś ca pañcamaḥ |

tasmād etat paraṃ manye yat-jantor asya sādhanam || 99
                                ||
senāpatyaṃ ca rājyaṃ ca daṇḍanetṛtvam eva ca |
yathā jāta.balo vahnir dahaty ārdrān api drumān |
tathā dahati vedajñaḥ karmajaṃ doṣam ātmanaḥ || 101 ||
iha-eva loke tiṣṭhan sa brahmabhūyāya kalpate || 102 ||
ajñebhyo granthinaḥ śreṣṭhā granthibhyo dhāriṇo varāḥ |
tapo vidyā ca viprasya niḥśreyasakaraṃ param |
pratyakṣaṃ ca-anumānaṃ ca śāstraṃ ca vividhā.āgamam |

yas tarkeṇa-anusandhatte sa dharmaṃ veda na-itaraḥ || 106
                                ||
an.āmnāteṣu dharmeṣu kathaṃ syād iti ced bhavet |

yaṃ śiṣṭā brāhmaṇā brūyuḥ sa dharmaḥ syād aśaṅkitaḥ || 108
                                ||

try.avarā vā-api vṛttasthā taṃ dharmaṃ na vicālayet || 110
                                ||

trayaś ca-āśramiṇaḥ pūrve pariṣat syād daśa.avarā || 111
                                ||
eko 'pi vedavid dharmaṃ yaṃ vyavasyed dvijottamaḥ |

sa vijñeyaḥ paro dharmo na-ajñānām udito 'yutaiḥ || 113
                                ||
yaṃ vadanti tamobhūtā mūrkhā dharmam atadvidaḥ |
asmād apracyuto vipraḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 116 ||
evaṃ sa bhagavān devo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |

dharmasya paramaṃ guhyaṃ mama-idaṃ sarvam uktavān || 117
                                ||

sarvaṃ hy ātmani sampaśyan na-adharme kurute manaḥ || 118
                                ||
ātmā-eva devatāḥ sarvāḥ sarvam ātmany avasthitam |
ātmā hi janayaty eṣāṃ karmayogaṃ śarīriṇām || 119 ||

pakti.dṛṣṭyoḥ paraṃ tejaḥ snehe 'po gāṃ ca mūrtiṣu || 120
                                ||
manasi-induṃ diśaḥ śrotre krānte viṣṇuṃ bale haram |

vācy agniṃ mitram utsarge prajane ca prajāpatim || 121
                                ||

rukma.ābhaṃ svapnadhīgamyaṃ vidyāt taṃ puruṣaṃ param || 122
                                ||
etam eke vadanty agniṃ manum anye prajāpatim |
indram eke pare prāṇam apare brahma śāśvatam || 123 ||
eṣa sarvāṇi bhūtāni pañcabhir vyāpya mūrtibhiḥ |
evaṃ yaḥ sarvabhūteṣu paśyaty ātmānam ātmanā |

sa sarvasamatām etya brahma-abhyeti paraṃ padam || 125
                                ||
ity etan mānavaṃ śāstraṃ bhṛguproktaṃ paṭhan dvijaḥ |

bhavaty ācāravān nityaṃ yathā.iṣṭāṃ prāpnuyād gatim || 126
                                ||
